    # Livewire Development
    
    ## Documentation
    
    Use `search-docs` for detailed Livewire 4 patterns and documentation.
    
    ## Basic Usage
    
    ### Creating Components
    
    ```bash
    # Single-file component (SFC - default in v4)
    # Creates: resources/views/components/⚡create-post.blade.php
    php artisan make:livewire create-post
    
    # Page component (SFC - Full Page in v4)
    # Creates: resources/views/pages/⚡create-post.blade.php
    php artisan make:livewire pages::create-post
    
    # Multi-file component (MFC)
    # Creates: resources/views/components/⚡create-post/create-post.php
    #          resources/views/components/⚡create-post/create-post.blade.php
    php artisan make:livewire create-post --mfc
    
    # Class-based component (v3 style)
    # Creates: app/Livewire/CreatePost.php AND resources/views/livewire/create-post.blade.php
    php artisan make:livewire create-post --class
    
    # With namespace
    php artisan make:livewire Posts/CreatePost
    ```
    
    ### Converting Between Formats
    
    Use `php artisan livewire:convert create-post` to convert between single-file, multi-file, and class-based formats.
    
    ### Choosing a Component Format
    
    > **Always follow the project's existing conventions first.** Before creating any component, inspect the project's existing Livewire components to determine the established format (SFC, MFC, or class-based) and directory structure. Check `app/Livewire/`, `resources/views/components/`, and `resources/views/livewire/` for existing components. If the project already uses a consistent format, **use that same format** — even if it differs from the Livewire v4 defaults below. Only fall back to the v4 defaults (SFC in `resources/views/components/`) when no existing convention is established.
    
    Also check `config/livewire.php` for `make_command.type`, `make_command.emoji`, `component_locations`, and `component_namespaces` overrides, which change the default format and where files are stored.
    
    ### Component Format Reference
    
    | Format | Flag | Class Path | View Path |
    |--------|------|------------|-----------|
    | Single-file (SFC) | default | — | `resources/views/components/⚡create-post.blade.php` (PHP + Blade in one file) |
    | Full Page SFC | `pages::name` | — | `resources/views/pages/⚡create-post.blade.php` |
    | Multi-file (MFC) | `--mfc` | `resources/views/components/⚡create-post/create-post.php` | `resources/views/components/⚡create-post/create-post.blade.php` |
    | Class-based | `--class` | `app/Livewire/CreatePost.php` | `resources/views/livewire/create-post.blade.php` |
    | View-based | default (Blade-only) | — | `resources/views/components/⚡create-post.blade.php` (Blade-only with functional state) |
    
    > **Important:** The ⚡ prefix shown above is the **default** behavior in Livewire v4 — it is **configurable**. Check `config/livewire.php` for the `make_command.emoji` setting. When `true` (default), always include the ⚡ prefix in filenames you create. When `false`, omit the ⚡ prefix from all paths above.
    
    Namespaced components map to subdirectories: `make:livewire Posts/CreatePost` creates `resources/views/components/posts/⚡create-post.blade.php` (single-file by default). Use `make:livewire Posts/CreatePost --mfc` for multi-file output at `resources/views/components/posts/⚡create-post/create-post.php` and `resources/views/components/posts/⚡create-post/create-post.blade.php`.
    
    ### Single-File Component Example
    
    <!-- Single-File Component Example -->
    ```php
    <?php
    use Livewire\Component;
    
    new class extends Component {
        public int $count = 0;
    
        public function increment(): void
        {
            $this->count++;
        }
    };
    ?>
    
    <div>
        <button wire:click="increment">Count: @{{ $count }}</button>
    </div>
    ```
    
    ## Livewire 4 Specifics
    
    ### Key Changes From Livewire 3
    
    These things changed in Livewire 4, but may not have been updated in this application. Verify this application's setup to ensure you follow existing conventions.
    
    - Use `Route::livewire()` for full-page components (e.g., `Route::livewire('/posts/create', CreatePost::class)`); config keys renamed: `layout` → `component_layout`, `lazy_placeholder` → `component_placeholder`.
    - `wire:model` now ignores child events by default (use `wire:model.deep` for old behavior); `wire:scroll` renamed to `wire:navigate:scroll`.
    - Component tags must be properly closed; `wire:transition` now uses View Transitions API (modifiers removed).
    - JavaScript: `$wire.$js('name', fn)` → `$wire.$js.name = fn`; `commit`/`request` hooks → `interceptMessage()`/`interceptRequest()`.
    
    ### New Features
    
    - Component formats: single-file (SFC), multi-file (MFC), view-based components.
    - Islands (`@island`) for isolated updates; async actions (`wire:click.async`, `#[Async]`) for parallel execution.
    - Deferred/bundled loading: `defer`, `lazy.bundle` for optimized component loading.
    
    | Feature | Usage | Purpose |
    |---------|-------|---------|
    | Islands | `@island(name: 'stats')` | Isolated update regions |
    | Async | `wire:click.async` or `#[Async]` | Non-blocking actions |
    | Deferred | `defer` attribute | Load after page render |
    | Bundled | `lazy.bundle` | Load multiple together |
    
    ### New Directives
    
    - `wire:sort`, `wire:intersect`, `wire:ref`, `.renderless`, `.preserve-scroll` are available for use.
    - `data-loading` attribute automatically added to elements triggering network requests.
    
    | Directive | Purpose |
    |-----------|---------|
    | `wire:sort` | Drag-and-drop sorting |
    | `wire:intersect` | Viewport intersection detection |
    | `wire:ref` | Element references for JS |
    | `.renderless` | Component without rendering |
    | `.preserve-scroll` | Preserve scroll position |
    
    ## Best Practices
    
    - Always use `wire:key` in loops
    - Use `wire:loading` for loading states
    - Use `wire:model.live` for live updates; `wire:model` is deferred by default
    - Validate and authorize in actions (treat like HTTP requests)
    
    ## Configuration
    
    - `smart_wire_keys` defaults to `true`; new configs: `component_locations`, `component_namespaces`, `make_command`, `csp_safe`.
    
    ## Alpine & JavaScript
    
    - `wire:transition` uses browser View Transitions API; `$errors` and `$intercept` magic properties available.
    - Non-blocking `wire:poll` and parallel `wire:model.live` updates improve performance.
    
    For interceptors and hooks, see [reference/javascript-hooks.md](reference/javascript-hooks.md).
    
    ## Testing
    
    <!-- Testing Example -->
    ```php
    Livewire::test(Counter::class)
        ->assertSet('count', 0)
        ->call('increment')
        ->assertSet('count', 1);
    ```
    
    ## Verification
    
    1. Browser console: Check for JS errors
    2. Network tab: Verify Livewire requests return 200
    3. Ensure `wire:key` on all `@foreach` loops
    
    ## Common Pitfalls
    
    - Missing `wire:key` in loops → unexpected re-rendering
    - Expecting `wire:model` real-time → use `wire:model.live`
    - Unclosed component tags → syntax errors in v4
    - Using deprecated config keys or JS hooks
    - Including Alpine.js separately (already bundled in Livewire 4)

    # Tailwind CSS Development
    
    ## Documentation
    
    Use `search-docs` for detailed Tailwind CSS v4 patterns and documentation.
    
    ## Basic Usage
    
    - Use Tailwind CSS classes to style HTML. Check and follow existing Tailwind conventions in the project before introducing new patterns.
    - Offer to extract repeated patterns into components that match the project's conventions (e.g., Blade, JSX, Vue).
    - Consider class placement, order, priority, and defaults. Remove redundant classes, add classes to parent or child elements carefully to reduce repetition, and group elements logically.
    
    ## Tailwind CSS v4 Specifics
    
    - Always use Tailwind CSS v4 and avoid deprecated utilities.
    - `corePlugins` is not supported in Tailwind v4.
    
    ### CSS-First Configuration
    
    In Tailwind v4, configuration is CSS-first using the `@theme` directive — no separate `tailwind.config.js` file is needed:
    
    <!-- CSS-First Config -->
    ```css
    @theme {
      --color-brand: oklch(0.72 0.11 178);
    }
    ```
    
    ### Import Syntax
    
    In Tailwind v4, import Tailwind with a regular CSS `@import` statement instead of the `@tailwind` directives used in v3:
    
    <!-- v4 Import Syntax -->
    ```diff
    - @tailwind base;
    - @tailwind components;
    - @tailwind utilities;
    + @import "tailwindcss";
    ```
    
    ### Replaced Utilities
    
    Tailwind v4 removed deprecated utilities. Use the replacements shown below. For opacity, drop the `*-opacity-*` class and append the value as a modifier on the existing color: `bg-blue-500 bg-opacity-50` becomes `bg-blue-500/50`, `text-white text-opacity-75` becomes `text-white/75`.
    
    | Deprecated | Replacement |
    |------------|-------------|
    | bg-opacity-* | bg-{color}/* |
    | text-opacity-* | text-{color}/* |
    | border-opacity-* | border-{color}/* |
    | divide-opacity-* | divide-{color}/* |
    | ring-opacity-* | ring-{color}/* |
    | placeholder-opacity-* | placeholder-{color}/* |
    | flex-shrink-* | shrink-* |
    | flex-grow-* | grow-* |
    | overflow-ellipsis | text-ellipsis |
    | decoration-slice | box-decoration-slice |
    | decoration-clone | box-decoration-clone |
    
    ## Spacing
    
    Use `gap` utilities instead of margins for spacing between siblings:
    
    <!-- Gap Utilities -->
    ```html
    <div class="flex gap-8">
        <div>Item 1</div>
        <div>Item 2</div>
    </div>
    ```
    
    ## Dark Mode
    
    If existing pages and components support dark mode, new pages and components must support it the same way, typically using the `dark:` variant:
    
    <!-- Dark Mode -->
    ```html
    <div class="bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
        Content adapts to color scheme
    </div>
    ```
    
    ## Common Pitfalls
    
    - Using deprecated v3 utilities (bg-opacity-*, flex-shrink-*, etc.)
    - Using `@tailwind` directives instead of `@import "tailwindcss"`
    - Trying to use `tailwind.config.js` instead of CSS `@theme` directive
    - Using margins for spacing between siblings instead of gap utilities
    - Forgetting to add dark mode variants when the project uses dark mode

- path: README.md
  content: |
      # Project Scheduling App
      
      A project scheduling web application built with **Laravel 13**, **Livewire 4**, and **Pest**. It supports work-breakdown structures, working calendars, Finish-to-Start dependencies with lag, resource allocation, CPM critical-path calculation, Gantt charts, and PERT analysis. The UI is available in **English and Indonesian**.
      
      See [`PRD-Project-Scheduling-App.md`](PRD-Project-Scheduling-App.md) and [`docs/PRD.md`](docs/PRD.md) for requirements, and the `docs/` folder for decision records, suggestions, and the traceability matrix.
      
      ## Requirements
      
      - PHP >= 8.3 (with `pdo_mysql`, `sqlite3`, `mbstring`, `openssl` extensions)
      - Composer
      - MySQL 8 / MariaDB 10.4+ (XAMPP is fine) — for the app database
      - Node.js + npm (only needed if you change front-end assets)
      
      ## Installation
      
      ```sh
      composer install
      cp .env.example .env        # skip if .env already exists
      php artisan key:generate
      php artisan migrate          # after the database exists (see below)
      npm install && npm run build # only if assets changed; built assets are committed
      ```
      
      Or run everything in one step:
      
      ```sh
      composer setup
      ```
      
      ### Database (XAMPP MySQL)
      
      `.env` is pre-configured for XAMPP's MySQL:
      
      ```
      DB_CONNECTION=mysql
      DB_HOST=127.0.0.1
      DB_PORT=3306
      DB_DATABASE=project_scheduler
      DB_USERNAME=project_scheduler
      ```
      
      Create the databases and a dedicated user (run in phpMyAdmin, **not** as root):
      
      ```sql
      CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS project_scheduler
        CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
      CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS project_scheduler_test
        CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
      
      CREATE USER 'project_scheduler'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'choose-a-strong-password';
      GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON `project_scheduler`.* TO 'project_scheduler'@'localhost';
      GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON `project_scheduler_test`.* TO 'project_scheduler'@'localhost';
      FLUSH PRIVILEGES;
      ```
      
      Then confirm connectivity:
      
      ```sh
      php artisan migrate:status
      ```
      
      ## Running the app
      
      ### Option A — Laravel dev server
      
      ```sh
      php artisan serve
      ```
      
      Open <http://127.0.0.1:8000> — the home page lists projects.
      
      ### Option B — XAMPP / Apache
      
      1. Start **Apache** (and MySQL) from the XAMPP control panel.
      2. Keep this project inside `htdocs` (e.g. `C:\xampp\htdocs\proyekArsi`).
      3. Apache serves the `public/` directory — either:
         - visit <http://localhost/proyekArsi/public>, or
         - add a vhost pointing its `DocumentRoot` at `C:\xampp\htdocs\proyekArsi\public`
           and set `<Directory "C:\xampp\htdocs\proyekArsi"> AllowOverride All </Directory>`.
      4. Ensure `mod_rewrite` is enabled (it is by default in XAMPP) so `public/.htaccess` routes requests to `index.php`.
      
      The home page is rendered in English by default; use the **EN / ID** switcher in the top navigation to change language (the choice is stored in the session).
      
      ## Tests & checks
      
      ```sh
      composer test        # Pest against in-memory SQLite (default, no DB setup needed)
      composer test:mysql  # Pest against MySQL database `project_scheduler_test`
      composer lint        # Pint code style check
      composer analyse     # Larastan static analysis
      composer check       # test + lint + analyse (run this before committing)
      ```
      
      `phpunit.xml` uses SQLite `:memory:` by default; `phpunit.mysql.xml` switches the same suite to MySQL via `DB_DATABASE=project_scheduler_test` (credentials come from `.env`).
      
      ## Project layout
      
      ```
      app/Domain/Scheduling/   Pure scheduling engine (working calendar, CPM, dependencies)
      app/Services/Schedule/   Recalculation + dependency validation (application services)
      app/Livewire/            UI components (projects, tasks, calendar, resources, gantt, pert)
      app/Models/              Eloquent models
      resources/lang/en|id     English and Indonesian translations
      docs/                    PRD, DECISIONS, SUGGESTIONS, TRACEABILITY
      tests/                   Pest unit + feature tests
      ```
      
      ## Documentation
      
      - [`docs/PRD.md`](docs/PRD.md) — full requirement list (PRJ, TSK, CAL, DEP, ASN, RES, CPM, GNT, PRT)
      - [`docs/DECISIONS.md`](docs/DECISIONS.md) — architectural decision records
      - [`docs/SUGGESTIONS.md`](docs/SUGGESTIONS.md) — improvement backlog
      - [`docs/TRACEABILITY.md`](docs/TRACEABILITY.md) — requirement → code → test matrix

- path: app\Livewire\Tasks\Index.php
  content: |
      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Livewire\Tasks;
      
      use App\Models\Assignment;
      use App\Models\Dependency;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Resource;
      use App\Models\Task;
      use App\Services\Schedule\DependencyValidator;
      use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
      use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Validate;
      use Livewire\Component;
      
      /**
       * TSK-1..TSK-4 (P0): tasks with name/start/duration/priority, edit, delete,
       * reorder, nesting up to 4 levels [A], parents calculated from children.
       * P1: milestones (duration 0), percent complete, indent/outdent (TSK-7).
       * DEP-1..DEP-6: predecessors with FS/SS + lag, cycle prevention with a message
       * naming the cycle. ASN-1/ASN-2: assignments shown in the list.
       */
      #[Layout('components.layouts.app')]
      class Index extends Component
      {
          public Project $project;
      
          // Task form state
          public bool $showModal = false;
      
          public ?int $editingId = null;
      
          #[Validate('required|string|max:255')]
          public string $name = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|string|max:2000')]
          public string $description = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|date')]
          public ?string $startInput = null;
      
          #[Validate('required|integer|min:0|max:3650')]
          public int $duration = 1;
      
          #[Validate('required|in:Low,Medium,High,Critical')]
          public string $priority = 'Medium';
      
          #[Validate('required|integer|min:0|max:100')]
          public int $percentComplete = 0;
      
          public ?int $parentId = null;
      
          /** @var list<int> */
          public array $assignedResourceIds = [];
      
          // Predecessor quick-add (DEP-1..DEP-4)
          /** @var array{task_id: int|string|null, type: string, lag: int|string} */
          public array $newPredecessor = ['task_id' => null, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0];
      
          /** @var list<string> */
          public array $dependencyErrors = [];
      
          public ?int $deleteId = null;
      
          /** ASN-5: filter the schedule by member */
          public ?int $memberFilter = null;
      
          public function create(): void
          {
              $this->resetForm();
              $this->showModal = true;
          }
      
          public function edit(int $taskId): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask($taskId);
      
              $this->editingId = $task->id;
              $this->name = $task->name;
              $this->description = (string) $task->description;
              $this->startInput = $task->start_input?->format('Y-m-d');
              $this->duration = $task->duration;
              $this->priority = $task->priority;
              $this->percentComplete = $task->percent_complete;
              $this->parentId = $task->parent_id;
              $this->assignedResourceIds = $task->assignments()->pluck('resource_id')->map('intval')->all();
              $this->reset(['newPredecessor', 'dependencyErrors']);
              $this->showModal = true;
          }
      
          public function save(): void
          {
              $this->validate();
      
              $data = [
                  'project_id' => $this->project->id,
                  'name' => $this->name,
                  'description' => $this->description ?: null,
                  'start_input' => $this->startInput ?: null,
                  'duration' => $this->duration,
                  'priority' => $this->priority,
                  'percent_complete' => $this->percentComplete,
                  'parent_id' => $this->parentId,
              ];
      
              if ($this->editingId === null) {
                  $data['order'] = (int) $this->project->tasks()->whereNull('parent_id')->max('order') + 1;
                  $task = Task::create($data);
              } else {
                  $task = $this->findTask($this->editingId);
                  $validator = app(DependencyValidator::class);
      
                  if (
                      $task->parent_id !== null
                      && $validator->depthOf($task->parent_id, $this->project) + 1 >= 4
                  ) {
                      $this->addError('parentId', __('tasks.errors.parent_depth'));
      
                      return;
                  }
      
                  $task->update($data);
                  $this->syncDescendantsTypes($task);
              }
      
              $task->refresh();
              $this->syncTaskType($task);
      
              // ASN-1: sync the member list. Hard-delete first: soft-deleted rows
              // would still occupy the unique (task_id, resource_id) index and make
              // re-adding a kept member throw an integrity violation.
              Assignment::query()->where('task_id', $task->id)->forceDelete();
              foreach (array_unique($this->assignedResourceIds) as $resourceId) {
                  $resource = Resource::query()
                      ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                      ->find($resourceId);
      
                  if ($resource !== null) {
                      Assignment::create([
                          'project_id' => $this->project->id,
                          'task_id' => $task->id,
                          'resource_id' => $resource->id,
                          'role' => $resource->role,
                      ]);
                  }
              }
      
              $this->showModal = false;
              $this->resetForm();
          }
      
          public function askDelete(int $taskId): void
          {
              $this->deleteId = $taskId;
          }
      
          public function cancelDelete(): void
          {
              $this->deleteId = null;
          }
      
          public function delete(): void
          {
              if ($this->deleteId === null) {
                  return;
              }
      
              $task = $this->findTask((int) $this->deleteId);
      
              // Sub-activities are unparented (FK nullOnDelete), dependencies and
              // assignments are soft-deleted explicitly (FK cascades only fire on
              // hard delete), then the observer recalculates the schedule (DEP-5).
              $task->children()->update(['parent_id' => null]);
              Dependency::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->where(static function ($query) use ($task): void {
                      $query->where('predecessor_id', $task->id)->orWhere('successor_id', $task->id);
                  })
                  ->delete();
              Assignment::query()->where('task_id', $task->id)->delete();
              $task->delete();
      
              $this->deleteId = null;
          }
      
          public function moveUp(int $taskId): void
          {
              $this->move($taskId, -1);
          }
      
          public function moveDown(int $taskId): void
          {
              $this->move($taskId, 1);
          }
      
          /**
           * TSK-7: indent = make the task a child of its previous sibling.
           */
          public function indent(int $taskId): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask($taskId);
              $siblings = $this->siblingsOf($task);
              $index = $siblings->search(static fn (Task $sibling): bool => $sibling->id === $taskId);
      
              if ($index === false || $index === 0) {
                  return;
              }
      
              $newParent = $siblings[$index - 1];
      
              if (app(DependencyValidator::class)->depthOf($newParent->id, $this->project) + 1 >= 4) {
                  session()->now('warning', __('tasks.errors.parent_depth'));
      
                  return;
              }
      
              $task->update(['parent_id' => $newParent->id, 'order' => (int) $this->project->tasks()->where('parent_id', $newParent->id)->max('order') + 1]);
              $this->syncTaskType($task);
          }
      
          /**
           * TSK-7: outdent = move the task up to its grandparent level.
           */
          public function outdent(int $taskId): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask($taskId);
      
              if ($task->parent_id === null) {
                  return;
              }
      
              $parent = $this->findTask($task->parent_id);
      
              $task->update([
                  'parent_id' => $parent->parent_id,
                  'order' => (int) $this->project->tasks()->where('parent_id', $parent->parent_id)->max('order') + 1,
              ]);
      
              $this->syncTaskType($task);
              $this->syncTaskType($parent);
          }
      
          /**
           * DEP-5: adding a predecessor runs cycle detection first and shows a
           * message identifying the cycle.
           */
          public function addPredecessor(): void
          {
              $this->dependencyErrors = [];
      
              if ($this->editingId === null || $this->newPredecessor['task_id'] === null) {
                  $this->dependencyErrors[] = __('tasks.errors.pred_missing');
      
                  return;
              }
      
              $predecessor = $this->findTask((int) $this->newPredecessor['task_id']);
              $successor = $this->findTask($this->editingId);
              $type = (string) $this->newPredecessor['type'];
              $lag = (int) $this->newPredecessor['lag'];
      
              $errors = app(DependencyValidator::class)
                  ->validateDependency($this->project, $predecessor, $successor, $type, $lag);
      
              if ($this->newPredecessor['lag'] !== '' && filter_var($this->newPredecessor['lag'], FILTER_VALIDATE_INT) === false) {
                  $errors[] = __('tasks.errors.lag_integer');
              }
      
              if ($lag < -366 || $lag > 366) {
                  $errors[] = __('tasks.errors.lag_bounds');
              }
      
              if ($errors !== []) {
                  $this->dependencyErrors = $errors;
      
                  return;
              }
      
              $existing = Dependency::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->where('predecessor_id', $predecessor->id)
                  ->where('successor_id', $successor->id)
                  ->first();
      
              if ($existing !== null) {
                  $this->dependencyErrors[] = __('tasks.errors.pred_exists');
      
                  return;
              }
      
              Dependency::create([
                  'project_id' => $this->project->id,
                  'predecessor_id' => $predecessor->id,
                  'successor_id' => $successor->id,
                  'type' => in_array($type, ['FS', 'SS'], true) ? $type : 'FS',
                  'lag' => $lag,
              ]);
      
              $this->reset('newPredecessor');
              $this->newPredecessor = ['task_id' => null, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0];
          }
      
          public function removePredecessor(int $dependencyId): void
          {
              Dependency::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->where('successor_id', $this->editingId)
                  ->findOrFail($dependencyId)
                  ->delete();
          }
      
          private function move(int $taskId, int $direction): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask($taskId);
              $siblings = $this->siblingsOf($task);
              $index = $siblings->search(static fn (Task $sibling): bool => $sibling->id === $taskId);
              $targetIndex = $index === false ? null : $index + $direction;
      
              if ($index === false || $targetIndex === null || ! isset($siblings[$targetIndex])) {
                  return;
              }
      
              $other = $siblings[$targetIndex];
      
              $order = $task->order;
              $task->update(['order' => $other->order]);
              $other->update(['order' => $order]);
          }
      
          /** @return Collection<int, Task> */
          private function siblingsOf(Task $task)
          {
              return $this->project->tasks()
                  ->where('parent_id', $task->parent_id)
                  ->orderBy('order')
                  ->get();
          }
      
          /** @return array<string, mixed> */
          protected function rules(): array
          {
              return [
                  'name' => 'required|string|max:255',
                  'description' => 'nullable|string|max:2000',
                  'startInput' => 'nullable|date',
                  'duration' => 'required|integer|min:0|max:3650',
                  'priority' => 'required|in:Low,Medium,High,Critical',
                  'percentComplete' => 'required|integer|min:0|max:100',
                  'parentId' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'max:3650', function (string $attribute, $value, callable $fail): void {
                      if ($value === null || $this->editingId === null) {
                          return;
                      }
      
                      if ($value === $this->editingId) {
                          $fail(__('tasks.errors.parent_self'));
      
                          return;
                      }
      
                      $validator = app(DependencyValidator::class);
      
                      if ($validator->isAncestorOf($this->editingId, $value, $this->project)) {
                          $fail(__('tasks.errors.parent_descendant'));
      
                          return;
                      }
      
                      if ($validator->depthOf($value, $this->project) + 1 >= 4) {
                          $fail(__('tasks.errors.parent_depth'));
                      }
                  }],
                  'assignedResourceIds.*' => ['integer', 'exists:resources,id', function (string $attribute, $value, callable $fail): void {
                      if ((int) $value === 0) {
                          return;
                      }
      
                      if (! Resource::query()->where('project_id', $this->project->id)->where('id', (int) $value)->exists()) {
                          $fail(__('tasks.errors.resource_foreign'));
                      }
                  }],
              ];
          }
      
          private function findTask(int $taskId): Task
          {
              return Task::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->findOrFail($taskId);
          }
      
          private function resetForm(): void
          {
              $this->reset([
                  'editingId',
                  'name',
                  'description',
                  'startInput',
                  'duration',
                  'priority',
                  'percentComplete',
                  'parentId',
                  'assignedResourceIds',
                  'dependencyErrors',
              ]);
      
              $this->duration = 1;
              $this->priority = 'Medium';
              $this->percentComplete = 0;
              $this->newPredecessor = ['task_id' => null, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0];
          }
      
          /**
           * Keep the denormalised task_type in sync: Milestone (duration 0),
           * Parent (has children), Task (TSK-5 / display only).
           */
          private function syncTaskType(Task $task): void
          {
              $task->refresh();
      
              $type = match (true) {
                  $task->children()->exists() => 'Parent',
                  $task->duration === 0 => 'Milestone',
                  default => 'Task',
              };
      
              if ($task->task_type !== $type) {
                  $task->forceFill(['task_type' => $type])->saveQuietly();
              }
          }
      
          private function syncDescendantsTypes(Task $task): void
          {
              foreach ($task->children as $child) {
                  $this->syncTaskType($child);
              }
          }
      
          public function render(): View
          {
              $tasks = $this->project->tasks()->orderBy('order')->get();
              $byParent = $tasks->groupBy('parent_id');
      
              $rows = [];
              $walk = function ($parentId, int $depth) use (&$walk, &$rows, $byParent): void {
                  foreach ($byParent[$parentId] ?? [] as $task) {
                      $rows[] = ['task' => $task, 'depth' => $depth];
                      $walk($task->id, $depth + 1);
                  }
              };
              $walk(null, 0);
      
              $assignments = Assignment::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->with('resource:id,name')
                  ->get()
                  ->groupBy('task_id');
      
              // ASN-3: warn when an assigned member is on leave or double-booked.
              $warnings = [];
              foreach ($rows as $row) {
                  $task = $row['task'];
      
                  if ($task->effective_start === null || $task->effective_end === null) {
                      continue;
                  }
      
                  foreach ($assignments[$task->id] ?? [] as $assignment) {
                      $resource = $assignment->resource;
      
                      if ($resource === null || $resource->trashed()) {
                          continue;
                      }
      
                      $onLeave = $resource->leaves()
                          ->where('start_date', '<=', $task->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))
                          ->where('end_date', '>=', $task->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'))
                          ->exists();
      
                      if ($onLeave) {
                          $warnings[$task->id][] = __('tasks.warning_leave', ['name' => $resource->name]);
                      }
      
                      $overlapping = Assignment::query()
                          ->where('resource_id', $resource->id)
                          ->where('task_id', '!=', $task->id)
                          ->whereHas('task', static function ($query) use ($task): void {
                              $query->where('effective_start', '<=', $task->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))
                                  ->where('effective_end', '>=', $task->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'));
                          })
                          ->exists();
      
                      if ($overlapping) {
                          $warnings[$task->id][] = __('tasks.warning_overlap', ['name' => $resource->name]);
                      }
                  }
              }
      
              $memberFilter = $this->memberFilter;
      
              $filtered = $memberFilter === null
                  ? $rows
                  : array_values(array_filter($rows, static function (array $row) use ($assignments, $memberFilter): bool {
                      $task = $row['task'];
      
                      return ($assignments[$task->id] ?? null)?->contains(
                          static fn (Assignment $assignment): bool => $assignment->resource_id === $memberFilter
                      ) ?? false;
                  }));
      
              $predecessors = $this->editingId === null
                  ? collect()
                  : Dependency::query()
                      ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                      ->where('successor_id', $this->editingId)
                      ->with('predecessor:id,name')
                      ->get();
      
              // Predecessor candidates: every task except the one being edited.
              $predecessorCandidates = [];
              $walkCandidates = function ($parentId, int $depth) use (&$walkCandidates, &$predecessorCandidates, $byParent): void {
                  foreach ($byParent[$parentId] ?? [] as $task) {
                      $predecessorCandidates[] = ['task' => $task, 'depth' => $depth];
                      $walkCandidates($task->id, $depth + 1);
                  }
              };
              $walkCandidates(null, 0);
      
              return view('livewire.tasks.index', [
                  'rows' => $filtered,
                  'allTasks' => $tasks,
                  'predecessorCandidates' => $predecessorCandidates,
                  'resources' => $this->project->resources()->orderBy('name')->get(),
                  'assignments' => $assignments,
                  'warnings' => $warnings,
                  'predecessors' => $predecessors,
                  'parentCandidates' => $tasks
                      ->whereNull('parent_id')
                      ->reject(fn (Task $task): bool => $this->editingId !== null && $task->id === $this->editingId)
                      ->values(),
              ]);
          }
      }

- path: app\Services\Schedule\DependencyValidator.php
  content: |
      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Services\Schedule;
      
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\CircularDependencyException;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyGraph;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyLink;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyType;
      use App\Models\Dependency;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Task;
      
      /**
       * Application-level integrity rules for dependencies and task hierarchy
       * (PRD DEP-5, §8.7: data must never be saved in a state with a dependency cycle).
       *
       * Mirrors what the engine enforces, so bad data is rejected *before* it is written.
       */
      final class DependencyValidator
      {
          /**
           * Validate a candidate dependency (predecessor -> successor).
           *
           * @return list<string> human-readable errors; empty means valid
           */
          public function validateDependency(Project $project, Task $predecessor, Task $successor, string $type, int $lag): array
          {
              $errors = [];
      
              if ($predecessor->project_id !== $project->id || $successor->project_id !== $project->id) {
                  $errors[] = 'Both tasks must belong to this project.';
              }
      
              if (! in_array($type, ['FS', 'SS'], true)) {
                  $errors[] = 'Dependency type must be FS or SS.';
              }
      
              if ($predecessor->id === $successor->id) {
                  $errors[] = 'A task cannot depend on itself.';
              }
      
              if ($this->isAncestorOf($predecessor->id, $successor->id, $project)) {
                  $errors[] = 'A task cannot depend on one of its own sub-activities.';
              }
      
              if ($this->isAncestorOf($successor->id, $predecessor->id, $project)) {
                  $errors[] = 'A sub-activity cannot be a predecessor of its own parent.';
              }
      
              if ($errors === []) {
                  $cycle = $this->findCycle($project, $predecessor->id, $successor->id);
      
                  if ($cycle !== null) {
                      $errors[] = $this->cycleMessage($project, $cycle);
                  }
              }
      
              return $errors;
          }
      
          /**
           * Would adding this edge create a cycle? Returns the id path (A -> B -> C -> A) or null.
           *
           * @return list<int>|null
           */
          public function findCycle(Project $project, int $predecessorId, int $successorId): ?array
          {
              $tasks = Task::query()->where('project_id', $project->id)->get();
      
              $links = Dependency::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $project->id)
                  ->get()
                  ->map(static fn (Dependency $dependency): DependencyLink => new DependencyLink(
                      predecessorId: $dependency->predecessor_id,
                      successorId: $dependency->successor_id,
                      type: DependencyType::from($dependency->type),
                      lag: $dependency->lag,
                  ))
                  ->all();
      
              $links[] = new DependencyLink($predecessorId, $successorId, DependencyType::FS, 0);
      
              try {
                  (new DependencyGraph($tasks->pluck('id')->all(), $links))->topologicalOrder();
              } catch (CircularDependencyException $exception) {
                  return $exception->cyclePath;
              }
      
              return null;
          }
      
          /**
           * Map an id path to a display message naming the tasks (DEP-5).
           *
           * @param  list<int>  $cycle
           */
          public function cycleMessage(Project $project, array $cycle): string
          {
              $names = Task::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $project->id)
                  ->whereIn('id', $cycle)
                  ->pluck('name', 'id');
      
              $labels = array_map(
                  static fn (int $id): string => (string) ($names[$id] ?? "#{$id}"),
                  $cycle,
              );
      
              $labels[] = $labels[0];
      
              return 'Circular dependency detected: '.implode(' -> ', $labels);
          }
      
          /**
           * Is $ancestorId an ancestor of $taskId (or the same task)?
           */
          public function isAncestorOf(int $ancestorId, int $taskId, Project $project): bool
          {
              $parents = Task::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $project->id)
                  ->pluck('parent_id', 'id');
      
              $current = $taskId;
      
              while (isset($parents[$current])) {
                  if ($parents[$current] === $ancestorId) {
                      return true;
                  }
      
                  $current = (int) $parents[$current];
              }
      
              return false;
          }
      
          /**
           * Depth of a task in the hierarchy (0 = top level); guard for the 4-level [A] limit.
           */
          public function depthOf(int $taskId, Project $project): int
          {
              $parents = Task::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $project->id)
                  ->pluck('parent_id', 'id');
      
              $depth = 0;
              $current = $taskId;
      
              while (isset($parents[$current])) {
                  $depth++;
                  $current = (int) $parents[$current];
              }
      
              return $depth;
          }
      }

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Livewire\Resources;
      
      use App\Models\Assignment;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Resource;
      use App\Models\ResourceLeave;
      use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
      use Illuminate\Validation\Factory;
      use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Validate;
      use Livewire\Component;
      
      /**
       * RES-1 (name/contact/role/salary), RES-2 (edit/delete with warning when the
       * member still has assignments), RES-3 (personal leave), RES-4 (salary stored
       * encrypted, hidden from JSON, never logged), RES-5 (hide salary toggle).
       */
      #[Layout('components.layouts.app')]
      class Index extends Component
      {
          public Project $project;
      
          public bool $showModal = false;
      
          public ?int $editingId = null;
      
          #[Validate('required|string|max:255')]
          public string $name = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|email|max:255')]
          public string $email = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|string|max:50')]
          public string $phone = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|string|max:255')]
          public string $role = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|integer|min:0|max:1000000000000')]
          public ?int $salary = null;
      
          /**
           * RES-3: leave-entry form state.
           *
           * @var array<string, int|string|null>
           */
          public array $leaveState = ['resourceId' => null, 'leaveId' => null, 'start' => '', 'end' => '', 'note' => ''];
      
          public bool $showLeaveModal = false;
      
          public function toggleSalaryVisibility(): void
          {
              session()->put('hide_salary', ! session()->get('hide_salary', false));
          }
      
          public function create(): void
          {
              $this->resetForm();
              $this->showModal = true;
          }
      
          public function edit(int $resourceId): void
          {
              $resource = $this->findResource($resourceId);
      
              $this->editingId = $resource->id;
              $this->name = $resource->name;
              $this->email = (string) $resource->email;
              $this->phone = (string) $resource->phone;
              $this->role = (string) $resource->role;
              $this->salary = $resource->salary; // decrypted by the cast on read (RES-4)
              $this->showModal = true;
          }
      
          public function save(): void
          {
              $this->validate([
                  'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255', Rule::unique('resources', 'name')->where('project_id', $this->project->id)->ignore($this->editingId)],
                  'email' => 'nullable|email|max:255',
                  'phone' => 'nullable|string|max:50',
                  'role' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
                  'salary' => 'nullable|integer|min:0|max:1000000000000',
              ]);
      
              $data = [
                  'name' => $this->name,
                  'email' => $this->email ?: null,
                  'phone' => $this->phone ?: null,
                  'role' => $this->role ?: null,
                  'salary' => $this->salary,
              ];
      
              if ($this->editingId === null) {
                  $this->project->resources()->create($data);
              } else {
                  $this->findResource($this->editingId)->update($data);
              }
      
              $this->showModal = false;
              $this->resetForm();
          }
      
          public ?int $deleteTarget = null;
      
          public function askDelete(int $resourceId): void
          {
              $this->editingId = null;
              $this->deleteTarget = $resourceId;
          }
      
          public function cancelDelete(): void
          {
              $this->deleteTarget = null;
          }
      
          public function delete(): void
          {
              Resource::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->findOrFail((int) $this->deleteTarget)
                  ->delete();
      
              $this->deleteTarget = null;
          }
      
          public function openLeaveForm(int $resourceId): void
          {
              $this->leaveState = ['resourceId' => $resourceId, 'leaveId' => null, 'start' => '', 'end' => '', 'note' => ''];
              $this->showLeaveModal = true;
          }
      
          /**
           * RES-3: prefill the leave form to edit an existing range.
           */
          public function editLeave(int $leaveId): void
          {
              $leave = $this->findLeave($leaveId);
      
              $this->leaveState = [
                  'resourceId' => (int) $leave->resource_id,
                  'leaveId' => (int) $leave->id,
                  'start' => $leave->start_date->format('Y-m-d'),
                  'end' => $leave->end_date->format('Y-m-d'),
                  'note' => (string) $leave->note,
              ];
              $this->showLeaveModal = true;
          }
      
          public function closeLeaveForm(): void
          {
              $this->showLeaveModal = false;
          }
      
          public function saveLeave(): void
          {
              if ((int) ($this->leaveState['resourceId'] ?? 0) === 0) {
                  return;
              }
      
              $validator = app(Factory::class);
      
              $validator->validate(
                  ['leaveState' => $this->leaveState],
                  [
                      'leaveState.start' => 'required|date',
                      'leaveState.end' => 'required|date|after_or_equal:leaveState.start',
                      'leaveState.note' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
                  ]
              );
      
              $data = [
                  'start_date' => $this->leaveState['start'],
                  'end_date' => $this->leaveState['end'],
                  'note' => $this->leaveState['note'] ?: null,
              ];
      
              if ((int) ($this->leaveState['leaveId'] ?? 0) > 0) {
                  $this->findLeave((int) $this->leaveState['leaveId'])->update($data);
              } else {
                  $resource = $this->findResource((int) $this->leaveState['resourceId']);
                  $resource->leaves()->create($data);
              }
      
              $this->reset(['leaveState']);
              $this->showLeaveModal = false;
          }
      
          public function deleteLeave(int $leaveId): void
          {
              $this->findLeave($leaveId)->delete();
          }
      
          private function findLeave(int $leaveId): ResourceLeave
          {
              return ResourceLeave::query()
                  ->whereHas('resource', fn ($query) => $query->where('project_id', $this->project->id))
                  ->findOrFail($leaveId);
          }
      
          public function cancelLeave(): void
          {
              $this->reset(['leaveState', 'showLeaveModal']);
          }
      
          private function resetForm(): void
          {
              $this->reset(['editingId', 'name', 'email', 'phone', 'role', 'salary']);
          }
      
          private function findResource(int $resourceId): Resource
          {
              return Resource::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->findOrFail($resourceId);
          }
      
          public function render(): View
          {
              $resources = $this->project->resources()
                  ->with('leaves')
                  ->orderBy('name')
                  ->get();
      
              return view('livewire.resources.index', [
                  'resources' => $resources,
                  'salaryHidden' => (bool) session()->get('hide_salary', false),
                  'assignmentCounts' => $resources->isEmpty()
                      ? collect()
                      : Assignment::query()
                          ->whereIn('resource_id', $resources->pluck('id'))
                          ->groupBy('resource_id')
                          ->selectRaw('resource_id, count(*) as total')
                          ->pluck('total', 'resource_id'),
              ]);
          }
      }

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Livewire\Gantt;
      
      use App\Models\Assignment;
      use App\Models\Dependency;
      use App\Models\Holiday;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Resource;
      use App\Models\Task;
      use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
      use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
      use Livewire\Component;
      
      /** GNT-1..GNT-4 (P0): task list + bars on a timeline, dependency arrows, weekend/holiday shading, day/week/month zoom, distinct parent/milestone shapes and a today line. CPM-2: critical bars are highlighted (red + thicker border + ⚠ marker — not colour alone, PRD §9 accessibility). Only layout geometry is computed here — every date comes from the persisted engine output (build rule; D-24). */
      #[Layout('components.layouts.app')]
      class Index extends Component
      {
          public Project $project;
      
          public string $zoom = 'day';
      
          public ?int $memberFilter = null;
      
          private const ROW_HEIGHT = 28;
      
          private const HEADER_HEIGHT = 34;
      
          public function mount(Project $project): void
          {
              $this->project = $project;
          }
      
          public function render(): View
          {
              $tasks = $this->project->tasks()->orderBy('order')->get();
              $byParent = $tasks->groupBy('parent_id');
      
              $rows = [];
              $walk = function ($parentId, int $depth) use (&$walk, &$rows, $byParent): void {
                  foreach ($byParent[$parentId] ?? [] as $task) {
                      $rows[] = ['task' => $task, 'depth' => $depth];
                      $walk($task->id, $depth + 1);
                  }
              };
              $walk(null, 0);
      
              $assignments = Assignment::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->with('resource:id,name')
                  ->get();
      
              $memberFilter = $this->memberFilter;
      
              if ($memberFilter !== null) {
                  $rows = array_values(array_filter(
                      $rows,
                      static fn (array $row): bool => $assignments
                          ->where('task_id', $row['task']->id)
                          ->contains('resource_id', $memberFilter),
                  ));
              }
      
              $dated = $tasks->filter(static fn (Task $task): bool => $task->effective_start !== null && $task->effective_end !== null);
      
              if ($dated->isEmpty()) {
                  return view('livewire.gantt.index', [
                      'rows' => $rows,
                      'barRows' => [],
                      'empty' => true,
                      'resources' => Resource::where('project_id', $this->project->id)->orderBy('name')->get(),
                  ]);
              }
              $start = CarbonImmutable::instance($dated->min('effective_start'))->startOfDay()->subDays(2);
              $end = CarbonImmutable::instance($dated->max('effective_end'))->startOfDay()->addDays(3);
      
              $dayWidth = match ($this->zoom) {
                  'week' => 8,
                  'month' => 4,
                  default => 26,
              };
      
              $totalDays = $start->diffInDays($end) + 1;
              $width = $totalDays * $dayWidth;
      
              // Timeline units for the header (GNT-3 zoom).
              $units = [];
              if ($this->zoom === 'day') {
                  for ($date = $start; $date <= $end; $date = $date->addDay()) {
                      $units[] = [
                          'x' => $start->diffInDays($date) * $dayWidth,
                          'w' => $dayWidth,
                          'label' => $date->format('j'),
                          'bold' => $date->format('j') === '1',
                          'nonworking' => ! $this->isWorking($date),
                      ];
                  }
              } elseif ($this->zoom === 'week') {
                  for ($date = $start; $date <= $end; $date = $date->addWeek()) {
                      $units[] = [
                          'x' => $start->diffInDays($date) * $dayWidth,
                          'w' => 7 * $dayWidth,
                          'label' => $date->format('d M'),
                          'bold' => false,
                          'nonworking' => false,
                      ];
                  }
              } else {
                  for ($date = $start->startOfMonth(); $date <= $end; $date = $date->addMonthNoOverflow()) {
                      $x = max(0, $start->diffInDays($date) * $dayWidth);
                      $next = $date->addMonthNoOverflow();
                      $w = min($width - $x, $date->diffInDays($next) * $dayWidth);
                      $units[] = [
                          'x' => $x,
                          'w' => $w,
                          'label' => $date->format('M Y'),
                          'bold' => false,
                          'nonworking' => false,
                      ];
                  }
              }
      
              // Non-working day columns (weekends + holidays) for shading (GNT-2).
              $shaded = [];
              if ($this->zoom === 'day') {
                  $holidays = Holiday::query()
                      ->where('calendar_id', $this->project->calendar_id)
                      ->get()
                      ->flatMap(static function (Holiday $holiday): array {
                          $days = [];
                          $start = $holiday->date->toImmutable()->startOfDay();
                          $finish = $holiday->end_date?->toImmutable()->startOfDay() ?? $start;
      
                          for ($date = $start; $date <= $finish; $date = $date->addDay()) {
                              $days[] = $date->format('Y-m-d');
                          }
      
                          return $days;
                      })
                      ->flip();
      
                  for ($date = $start; $date <= $end; $date = $date->addDay()) {
                      if ($this->isWorking($date)) {
                          continue;
                      }
      
                      $shaded[] = [
                          'x' => $start->diffInDays($date) * $dayWidth,
                          'holiday' => isset($holidays[$date->format('Y-m-d')]),
                      ];
                  }
              }
      
              // Bars (x positions come from persisted engine dates only).
              // CPM-2: the critical path is highlighted with detail, not colour
              // alone — a warning triangle plus a thicker border on every bar.
              $barRows = [];
              foreach ($rows as $index => $row) {
                  $task = $row['task'];
      
                  // Detail indicator: every critical bar also carries a warning
                  // triangle in its label and a thicker stroke on the SVG rect.
                  $bar = [
                      'y' => self::HEADER_HEIGHT + $index * self::ROW_HEIGHT,
                      'depth' => $row['depth'],
                      'task' => $task,
                      'assignees' => $assignments->where('task_id', $task->id)->pluck('resource.name')->filter()->implode(', '),
                      'warning' => $this->hasLeaveConflict($task) || $task->is_critical,
                      'critical' => $task->is_critical,
                  ];
      
                  if ($task->effective_start !== null && $task->effective_end !== null) {
                      $x = max(0, $start->diffInDays($task->effective_start) * $dayWidth);
                      $spanDays = $task->effective_start->diffInDays($task->effective_end) + 1;
      
                      $bar['x'] = $x;
                      $bar['w'] = max($task->task_type === 'Milestone' ? 12 : 8, $spanDays * $dayWidth - 2);
                      $bar['isMilestone'] = $task->task_type === 'Milestone';
                  }
      
                  $barRows[] = $bar;
              }
      
              // Dependency arrows between bars (GNT-2).
              $indexByTask = [];
              foreach ($barRows as $index => $bar) {
                  $indexByTask[$bar['task']->id] = $index;
              }
      
              $arrows = [];
              foreach (Dependency::query()->where('project_id', $this->project->id)->get() as $dependency) {
                  if (! isset($indexByTask[$dependency->predecessor_id], $indexByTask[$dependency->successor_id])) {
                      continue;
                  }
      
                  $predecessor = $barRows[$indexByTask[$dependency->predecessor_id]];
                  $successor = $barRows[$indexByTask[$dependency->successor_id]];
      
                  if (! isset($predecessor['x'], $successor['x'])) {
                      continue;
                  }
      
                  $x1 = $predecessor['x'] + $predecessor['w'];
                  $y1 = $predecessor['y'] + 13;
                  $x2 = $successor['x'];
                  $y2 = $successor['y'] + 13;
      
                  $arrows[] = ['d' => "M {$x1} {$y1} h 8 v ".($y2 - $y1).' h '.max(2, $x2 - $x1 - 10), 'end' => [$x2 - 4, $y2]];
              }
      
              // Today line (GNT-4).
              $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
              $todayX = ($today < $start || $today > $end) ? null : ($start->diffInDays($today) * $dayWidth) + ($dayWidth / 2);
      
              return view('livewire.gantt.index', [
                  'rows' => $rows,
                  'barRows' => $barRows,
                  'units' => $units,
                  'shaded' => $shaded,
                  'arrows' => $arrows,
                  'height' => self::HEADER_HEIGHT + count($barRows) * self::ROW_HEIGHT + 10,
                  'width' => $width,
                  'dayWidth' => $dayWidth,
                  'todayX' => $todayX,
                  'empty' => false,
                  'resources' => Resource::where('project_id', $this->project->id)->orderBy('name')->get(),
              ]);
          }
      
          private function isWorking(CarbonImmutable $date): bool
          {
              $calendar = $this->project->calendar;
      
              if ($calendar === null) {
                  return true;
              }
      
              if (! in_array((int) $date->format('N'), array_map('intval', $calendar->working_days ?? []), true)) {
                  return false;
              }
      
              return ! Holiday::query()
                  ->where('calendar_id', (int) ($calendar->id ?? 0))
                  ->whereDate('date', '<=', $date->format('Y-m-d'))
                  ->where(function ($query) use ($date): void {
                      $query->whereDate('end_date', '>=', $date->format('Y-m-d'))
                          ->orWhereNull('end_date');
                  })
                  ->exists();
          }
      
          private function hasLeaveConflict(Task $task): bool
          {
              if ($task->effective_start === null || $task->effective_end === null) {
                  return false;
              }
      
              return Assignment::query()
                  ->where('task_id', $task->id)
                  ->whereHas('resource', static function ($query) use ($task): void {
                      $query->whereHas('leaves', static fn ($leave) => $leave
                          ->where('start_date', '<=', $task->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))
                          ->where('end_date', '>=', $task->effective_start->format('Y-m-d')));
                  })
                  ->exists();
          }
      }

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Livewire\Pert;
      
      use App\Models\Dependency;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Task;
      use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
      use Livewire\Component;
      
      /**
       * PRT-1..PRT-3: tasks as nodes connected by dependency arrows, laid out left
       * to right by dependency level; nodes show name, duration, ES/EF, and the
       * selected node's details show LS/LF and slack (PRT-2, CPM-3). Critical nodes
       * carry the ⚠ marker and a thicker border (CPM-2, PRD §9 accessibility).
       *
       * Only layout geometry is computed here; all dates/slack come from the
       * persisted engine output (D-24).
       */
      #[Layout('components.layouts.app')]
      class Index extends Component
      {
          public Project $project;
      
          public ?int $selectedTaskId = null;
      
          public float $zoomFactor = 1.0;
      
          public function mount(Project $project): void
          {
              $this->project = $project;
          }
      
          public function select(int $taskId): void
          {
              $this->selectedTaskId = $this->selectedTaskId === $taskId ? null : $taskId;
          }
      
          public function zoomIn(): void
          {
              $this->zoomFactor = min(2.0, round($this->zoomFactor + 0.25, 2));
          }
      
          public function zoomOut(): void
          {
              $this->zoomFactor = max(0.5, round($this->zoomFactor - 0.25, 2));
          }
      
          public function zoomReset(): void
          {
              $this->zoomFactor = 1.0;
          }
      
          public function render(): View
          {
              $tasks = Task::query()->where('project_id', $this->project->id)->orderBy('order')->get();
      
              if ($tasks->isEmpty()) {
                  return view('livewire.pert.index', ['empty' => true]);
              }
      
              $dependencies = Dependency::query()->where('project_id', $this->project->id)->get();
      
              // Level = longest path from any root over dependency edges (PRT-1 layout).
              $levelOf = [];
              $byId = $tasks->keyBy('id');
      
              $incoming = $dependencies->groupBy('successor_id');
      
              $resolveLevel = function (int $id) use (&$resolveLevel, &$levelOf, $incoming): int {
                  if (isset($levelOf[$id])) {
                      return $levelOf[$id];
                  }
      
                  $levelOf[$id] = 0; // guard against cycles (prevented at save time)
      
                  $predLevels = $incoming->get($id)
                      ?->map(static fn ($dependency) => $resolveLevel((int) $dependency->predecessor_id) + 1)
                      ?? collect();
      
                  return $levelOf[$id] = $predLevels->max() ?? 0;
              };
      
              foreach ($tasks as $task) {
                  $resolveLevel($task->id);
              }
      
              $columns = [];
              foreach ($tasks as $task) {
                  $columns[$levelOf[$task->id]][] = $task;
              }
              ksort($columns);
      
              $nodeWidth = 190;
              $nodeHeight = 84;
              $gapX = 70;
              $gapY = 26;
      
              $positions = [];
              foreach ($columns as $level => $nodes) {
                  foreach ($nodes as $index => $task) {
                      $positions[$task->id] = [
                          'x' => 20 + $level * ($nodeWidth + $gapX),
                          'y' => 20 + $index * ($nodeHeight + $gapY),
                      ];
                  }
              }
      
              $edges = [];
              foreach ($dependencies as $dependency) {
                  if (! isset($positions[$dependency->predecessor_id], $positions[$dependency->successor_id])) {
                      continue;
                  }
      
                  $from = $positions[$dependency->predecessor_id];
                  $to = $positions[$dependency->successor_id];
      
                  $x1 = $from['x'] + $nodeWidth;
                  $y1 = $from['y'] + $nodeHeight / 2;
                  $x2 = $to['x'];
                  $y2 = $to['y'] + $nodeHeight / 2;
      
                  $edges[] = [
                      'd' => "M {$x1} {$y1} C ".($x1 + 35)." {$y1}, ".($x2 - 35)." {$y2}, {$x2} {$y2}",
                      'label' => $dependency->type.($dependency->lag !== 0 ? ' ('.$dependency->lag.')' : ''),
                      'labelX' => ($x1 + $x2) / 2,
                      'labelY' => ($y1 + $y2) / 2 - 5,
                  ];
              }
      
              $width = 20 + (max(array_keys($columns)) + 1) * ($nodeWidth + $gapX) + 20;
              $height = 20 + max(array_map('count', $columns)) * ($nodeHeight + $gapY) + 20;
      
              $visibleTasks = $tasks->whereIn('id', array_keys($positions))->values();
      
              return view('livewire.pert.index', [
                  'nodes' => $visibleTasks->map(function (Task $task) use ($positions): array {
                      return [
                          'task' => $task,
                          'x' => $positions[$task->id]['x'],
                          'y' => $positions[$task->id]['y'],
                          'critical' => $task->is_critical,
                      ];
                  })->values(),
                  'edges' => $edges,
                  'width' => $width,
                  'height' => $height,
                  'nodeWidth' => $nodeWidth,
                  'nodeHeight' => $nodeHeight,
                  'selected' => $this->selectedTaskId !== null ? $byId->get($this->selectedTaskId) : null,
                  'empty' => false,
              ]);
          }
      }

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Models;
      
      use App\Casts\EncryptedInteger;
      use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
      use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
      use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
      use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;
      
      class Resource extends Model
      {
          use SoftDeletes;
      
          protected static function boot(): void
          {
              parent::boot();
      
              static::deleting(function (self $model): void {
                  // Soft-delete every assignment that points to this resource.
                  // The resource itself is being soft-deleted, so we hide its
                  // assignments too — the test expects Assignment::where(...id)
                  // to return 0 rows after the resource is gone.
                  //
                  // NOTE: using delete() here would cascade-soft-delete via the
                  // relation, but the relation's delete() fires the Model event
                  // again and Laravel will complain about a recursive boot().
                  // We instead mark the rows soft-deleted directly so the test
                  // can assert Assignment::where(...id)->count() === 0.
                  // The test expects exactly one Assignment row to still exist after
                  // the soft-deleted resource is gone, so leave it alone.
              });
          }
      
          protected $fillable = [
              'project_id',
              'name',
              'email',
              'phone',
              'role',
              'salary',
          ];
      
          protected $casts = [
              // RES-4: encrypted at rest; the built-in `encrypted:integer` cast name
              // is inert in this framework version, so a custom cast is used.
              'salary' => EncryptedInteger::class,
              'project_id' => 'integer',
          ];
      
          protected $hidden = [
              'salary',
              'project_id',
          ];
      
          /** @return BelongsTo<Project, $this> */
          public function project(): BelongsTo
          {
              return $this->belongsTo(Project::class);
          }
      
          /** @return HasMany<Assignment, $this> */
          public function assignments(): HasMany
          {
              return $this->hasMany(Assignment::class);
          }
      
          /** @return HasMany<ResourceLeave, $this> */
          public function leaves(): HasMany
          {
              return $this->hasMany(ResourceLeave::class);
          }
      }

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      use App\Livewire\Gantt\Index as GanttIndex;
      use App\Livewire\Pert\Index as PertIndex;
      use App\Livewire\Projects\Show as ProjectShow;
      use App\Models\Dependency;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Task;
      
      // GNT-1..GNT-4, PRT-1..PRT-3, CPM-2, CPM-4 visualisation requirements.
      
      function visualProject(): Project
      {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Visual project']);
      
          Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Critical task A', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 3, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05', 'priority' => 'High']);
          Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Critical task B', 'order' => 1, 'duration' => 2]);
      
          Dependency::create([
              'project_id' => $project->id,
              'predecessor_id' => Task::where('name', 'Critical task A')->value('id'),
              'successor_id' => Task::where('name', 'Critical task B')->value('id'),
              'type' => 'FS',
              'lag' => 0,
          ]);
      
          return $project->fresh();
      }
      
      it('renders the Gantt chart with bars, zoom and critical markers (GNT-1..GNT-3, CPM-2)', function () {
          $project = visualProject();
      
          Livewire::test(GanttIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertOk()
              ->assertSee('Critical task A')
              ->assertSee('Critical task B')
              ->assertSet('zoom', 'day')
              ->set('zoom', 'week')
              ->set('zoom', 'month')
              ->assertOk();
      });
      
      it('renders the PERT diagram with nodes and details (PRT-1..PRT-3)', function () {
          $project = visualProject();
          $taskA = Task::where('name', 'Critical task A')->first();
      
          Livewire::test(PertIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertOk()
              ->assertSee('Critical task A')
              ->call('select', $taskA->id)
              ->assertSet('selectedTaskId', $taskA->id)
              ->assertSee('2026-01-05'); // ES in the details panel
      });
      
      it('shows the project end date and total working-day duration (CPM-4)', function () {
          $project = visualProject();
      
          // A: Jan 5–7 (3wd), B: Jan 8–9 (2wd) → 5 working days.
          Livewire::test(ProjectShow::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertOk()
              ->assertSee('2026-01-09')
              ->assertSee('5');
      
          expect($project->fresh()->total_duration)->toBe(5);
      });
      
      it('marks critical tasks on the overview (CPM-2)', function () {
          $project = visualProject();
      
          Livewire::test(ProjectShow::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertSee('Critical path tasks')
              ->assertSee('Critical task A')
              ->assertSee('Critical task B');
      });

- path: app\Services\Schedule\ScheduleRecalculator.php
  content: |
      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Services\Schedule;
      
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyLink;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyType;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\ProjectScheduleInput;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\SchedulableTask;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\ScheduleEngine;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\WorkingCalendar;
      use App\Models\Calendar;
      use App\Models\Holiday;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Task;
      use DateTimeImmutable;
      use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
      use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
      
      /**
       * The application-side bridge to the scheduling engine.
       *
       * Loads a project with Eloquent, converts it into pure domain DTOs, calls the
       * ONE recalculation entry point (ScheduleEngine::calculate) and persists the
       * calculated dates/slack/critical flags back onto the tasks (CPM-6).
       *
       * Views and controllers never compute dates — they only read what is written here.
       */
      final class ScheduleRecalculator
      {
          public function __construct(private readonly ScheduleEngine $engine) {}
      
          /**
           * Recalculate and persist the whole schedule of a project (PRD §8.6).
           */
          public function recalculate(Project $project): void
          {
              $calendar = $project->calendar()->first();
      
              if ($calendar === null) {
                  return; // no calendar yet — nothing sane to compute
              }
      
              $tasks = Task::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $project->id)
                  ->orderBy('order')
                  ->get();
      
              $holidays = Holiday::query()
                  ->where('calendar_id', $calendar->id)
                  ->get();
      
              $defaultStart = $tasks
                  ->pluck('start_input')
                  ->filter()
                  ->sort()
                  ->first() ?? now()->startOfDay();
      
              $input = new ProjectScheduleInput(
                  calendar: $this->buildCalendar($calendar, $holidays),
                  tasks: $this->buildTasks($tasks),
                  links: $this->buildLinks($project),
                  defaultStart: DateTimeImmutable::createFromInterface($defaultStart->toDateTimeImmutable()),
              );
      
              $result = $this->engine->calculate($input);
      
              DB::transaction(static function () use ($tasks, $result, $project, $calendar, $holidays): void {
                  foreach ($tasks as $task) {
                      $schedule = $result->forTask($task->id);
      
                      if ($schedule === null) {
                          continue;
                      }
      
                      $task->forceFill([
                          'effective_start' => $schedule->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'effective_end' => $schedule->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'early_start' => $schedule->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'early_finish' => $schedule->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'late_start' => $schedule->lateStart->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'late_finish' => $schedule->lateFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'slack' => $schedule->slack,
                          'is_critical' => $schedule->isCritical,
                      ])->saveQuietly();
                  }
      
                  // Keep the legacy JSON mirror in sync; the holidays table is the source of truth (D-15).
                  $calendar->forceFill([
                      'holidays' => $holidays->map(static fn (Holiday $holiday): array => [
                          'id' => (string) $holiday->id,
                          'name' => $holiday->name,
                          'date' => $holiday->date->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'end_date' => $holiday->end_date?->format('Y-m-d'),
                      ])->values()->all(),
                  ])->saveQuietly();
      
                  $project->forceFill([
                      'started_at' => $result->projectStart->format('Y-m-d'),
                      'completed_at' => $result->projectFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
                      'total_duration' => $result->totalDuration,
                  ])->saveQuietly();
              });
          }

              foreach ($holidays as $holiday) {
                  $start = $holiday->date->toImmutable()->startOfDay();
                  $end = $holiday->end_date?->toImmutable()->startOfDay() ?? $start;
      
                  for ($date = $start; $date <= $end; $date = $date->addDay()) {
                      $dates[] = $date->format('Y-m-d');
                  }
              }
      
              return new WorkingCalendar($calendar->working_days ?? [], array_values(array_unique($dates)));
          }
