      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Services\Schedule;
      
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyLink;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyType;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\ProjectScheduleInput;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\SchedulableTask;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\ScheduleEngine;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\ScheduleResult;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\WorkingCalendar;
      use App\Models\Calendar;
      use App\Models\Holiday;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Task;
      use DateTimeImmutable;
      use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
      use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
      
      /**
       * The application-side bridge to the scheduling engine.
       *
       * Loads a project with Eloquent, converts it into pure domain DTOs, calls the
       * ONE recalculation entry point (ScheduleEngine::calculate) and persists the
       * calculated dates/slack/critical flags back onto the tasks (CPM-6).
       *
       * Views and controllers never compute dates — they only read what is written here.
       */
      final class ScheduleRecalculator
      {
          public function __construct(private readonly ScheduleEngine $engine) {}
      
          /**
           * Recalculate and persist the whole schedule of a project (PRD §8.6).
           */
          public function recalculate(Project $project): void
          {
              $calendar = $project->calendar()->first();
      
              if ($calendar === null) {
                  return; // no calendar yet — nothing sane to compute
              }
      
              $tasks = Task::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $project->id)
                  ->orderBy('order')
                  ->get();
      
              $holidays = Holiday::query()
                  ->where('calendar_id', $calendar->id)
                  ->get();
      
              $defaultStart = $tasks
                  ->pluck('start_input')
                  ->filter()
                  ->sort()
                  ->first() ?? now()->startOfDay();
      
              $input = new ProjectScheduleInput(
                  calendar: $this->buildCalendar($calendar, $holidays),
                  tasks: $this->buildTasks($tasks),
                  links: $this->buildLinks($project),
                  defaultStart: DateTimeImmutable::createFromInterface($defaultStart->toDateTimeImmutable()),
              );
      
              $result = $this->engine->calculate($input);
      
              DB::transaction(static function () use ($tasks, $result, $project, $calendar, $holidays): void {
                  // Bulk-write the engine output with one UPDATE-per-field-CASE
                  // statement instead of 500 saveQuietly() calls (PRD §8.6 target:
                  // recalculation under 1s for 500 tasks).
                  self::persistSchedules($tasks, $result);
      
                  // Keep the legacy JSON mirror in sync; the holidays table is the source of truth (D-15).
                  $calendar->forceFill([
                      'holidays' => $holidays->map(static fn (Holiday $holiday): array => [
                          'id' => (string) $holiday->id,
                          'name' => $holiday->name,
                          'date' => $holiday->date->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'end_date' => $holiday->end_date?->format('Y-m-d'),
                      ])->values()->all(),
                  ])->saveQuietly();
      
                  $project->forceFill([
                      'started_at' => $result->projectStart->format('Y-m-d'),
                      'completed_at' => $result->projectFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
                      'total_duration' => $result->totalDuration,
                  ])->saveQuietly();
              });
          }
      
          /**
           * Persist the computed schedule columns in one bulk UPDATE per column
           * (multiple UPDATE statements, one row-scan each, no per-row round-trips).
           *
           * @param  Collection<int, Task>  $tasks
           */
          private static function persistSchedules($tasks, ScheduleResult $result): void
          {
              $ids = [];
              /** @var array<string, array<int, string|int|bool>> $byColumn column => id => value */
              $byColumn = [
                  'effective_start' => [],
                  'effective_end' => [],
                  'early_start' => [],
                  'early_finish' => [],
                  'late_start' => [],
                  'late_finish' => [],
                  'slack' => [],
                  'is_critical' => [],
              ];
      
              foreach ($tasks as $task) {
                  $schedule = $result->forTask($task->id);
      
                  if ($schedule === null) {
                      continue;
                  }
      
                  $ids[] = $task->id;
                  $byColumn['effective_start'][$task->id] = $schedule->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d');
                  $byColumn['effective_end'][$task->id] = $schedule->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d');
                  $byColumn['early_start'][$task->id] = $schedule->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d');
                  $byColumn['early_finish'][$task->id] = $schedule->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d');
                  $byColumn['late_start'][$task->id] = $schedule->lateStart->format('Y-m-d');
                  $byColumn['late_finish'][$task->id] = $schedule->lateFinish->format('Y-m-d');
                  $byColumn['slack'][$task->id] = $schedule->slack;
                  $byColumn['is_critical'][$task->id] = $schedule->isCritical;
              }
      
              if ($ids === []) {
                  return;
              }
      
              // Tell observers these rows were recalculated by this very pass, so the
              // ScheduleObserver must not re-trigger (it would recurse otherwise).
              Task::withoutEvents(static function () use ($ids, $byColumn): void {
                  foreach ($byColumn as $column => $values) {
                      $cases = '';
                      $bindings = [];
      
                      foreach ($values as $id => $value) {
                          $cases .= ' WHEN id = ? THEN ?';
                          $bindings[] = $id;
                          $bindings[] = $value;
                      }
      
                      $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($ids), '?'));
      
                      DB::update(
                          "update tasks set {$column} = case{$cases} else {$column} end, updated_at = ? where id in ({$placeholders}) and deleted_at is null",
                          [...$bindings, now(), ...$ids],
                      );
                  }
              });
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  Collection<int, Holiday>  $holidays
           */
          private function buildCalendar(Calendar $calendar, $holidays): WorkingCalendar
          {
              $dates = [];
      
              foreach ($holidays as $holiday) {
                  $start = $holiday->date->toImmutable()->startOfDay();
                  $end = $holiday->end_date?->toImmutable()->startOfDay() ?? $start;
      
                  for ($date = $start; $date <= $end; $date = $date->addDay()) {
                      $dates[] = $date->format('Y-m-d');
                  }
              }
      
              return new WorkingCalendar($calendar->working_days ?? [], array_values(array_unique($dates)));
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  Collection<int, Task>  $tasks
           * @return list<SchedulableTask>
           */
          private function buildTasks($tasks): array
          {
              return $tasks->map(static fn (Task $task): SchedulableTask => new SchedulableTask(
                  id: $task->id,
                  parentId: $task->parent_id,
                  position: $task->order,
                  name: $task->name,
                  requestedStart: $task->start_input === null
                      ? null
                      : DateTimeImmutable::createFromInterface($task->start_input->toDateTimeImmutable()),
                  duration: $task->duration,
              ))->all();
          }
      
          /**
           * @return list<DependencyLink>
           */
          private function buildLinks(Project $project): array
          {
              $taskIds = Task::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $project->id)
                  ->pluck('id')
                  ->all();
      
              // Skip stale links whose endpoints are gone (defense in depth: the
              // UI removes dependency rows on task delete, but stale data must
              // never wedge the recalculation).
              return $project->dependencies()
                  ->get()
                  ->filter(static fn ($dependency): bool => in_array($dependency->predecessor_id, $taskIds, true)
                      && in_array($dependency->successor_id, $taskIds, true))
                  ->map(static fn ($dependency): DependencyLink => new DependencyLink(
                      predecessorId: $dependency->predecessor_id,
                      successorId: $dependency->successor_id,
                      type: DependencyType::from($dependency->type),
                      lag: $dependency->lag,
                  ))
                  ->values()
                  ->all();
          }
      }

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      use App\Livewire\Tasks\Index as TasksIndex;
      use App\Models\Assignment;
      use App\Models\Dependency;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Resource;
      use App\Models\Task;
      
      // TSK-1..TSK-7 task management requirements.
      
      function makeProject(): Project
      {
          return Project::create(['name' => 'Tasks project']);
      }
      
      it('requires a name and a non-negative duration (TSK-1)', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->set('name', '')
              ->set('duration', -1)
              ->call('save')
              ->assertHasErrors(['name' => 'required', 'duration']);
      });
      
      it('moves a non-working start to the next working day and calculates the end (TSK-1 AC)', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->set('name', 'Weekend start')
              ->set('startInput', '2026-01-10') // Saturday
              ->set('duration', 2)
              ->call('save')
              ->assertHasNoErrors();
      
          $task = Task::first();
      
          // Start moves to Monday Jan 12; 2 working days end Tuesday Jan 13.
          expect($task->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')
              ->and($task->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-13');
      });
      
      it('reorders tasks among siblings (TSK-2)', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          foreach (['Alpha', 'Beta'] as $index => $name) {
              Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => $name, 'order' => $index, 'duration' => 1, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
          }
      
          $beta = Task::where('name', 'Beta')->first();
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('moveUp', $beta->id);
      
          expect(Task::where('name', 'Beta')->value('order'))->toBe(0)
              ->and(Task::where('name', 'Alpha')->value('order'))->toBe(1);
      });
      
      it('nests tasks and rejects cyclic or too-deep parents (TSK-3)', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          foreach (['L1', 'L2', 'L3', 'L4', 'L5'] as $index => $name) {
              Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => $name, 'order' => $index, 'duration' => 1, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
          }
      
          [$l1, $l2, $l3, $l4, $l5] = Task::orderBy('order')->get()->all();
      
          // Build a 4-level chain: L2 under L1, L3 under L2, L4 under L3.
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('edit', $l2->id)->set('parentId', $l1->id)->call('save')->assertHasNoErrors()
              ->call('edit', $l3->id)->set('parentId', $l2->id)->call('save')->assertHasNoErrors()
              ->call('edit', $l4->id)->set('parentId', $l3->id)->call('save')->assertHasNoErrors();
      
          // A 5th level must be rejected [A: max 4 levels].
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('edit', $l5->id)
              ->set('parentId', $l4->id)
              ->call('save')
              ->assertHasErrors(['parentId']);
      
          // A task cannot become its own parent or nest under its child.
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('edit', $l1->id)
              ->set('parentId', $l1->id)
              ->call('save')
              ->assertHasErrors(['parentId']);
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('edit', $l1->id)
              ->set('parentId', $l2->id)
              ->call('save')
              ->assertHasErrors(['parentId']);
      });
      
      it('calculates parent tasks from their children (TSK-4)', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          $parent = Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Phase 1', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 99, 'start_input' => '2026-02-01']);
      
          Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Child A', 'parent_id' => $parent->id, 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 2, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
          Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Child B', 'parent_id' => $parent->id, 'order' => 1, 'duration' => 3, 'start_input' => '2026-01-08']);
      
          $parent->refresh();
      
          // Parent ignores its own start/duration and rolls up: Jan 5 .. Jan 12.
          expect($parent->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05')
              ->and($parent->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12');
      });
      
      it('supports milestones with duration zero (TSK-5)', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->set('name', 'Go live')
              ->set('startInput', '2026-01-09')
              ->set('duration', 0)
              ->call('save');
      
          $milestone = Task::first();
      
          expect($milestone->task_type)->toBe('Milestone')
              ->and($milestone->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-09')
              ->and($milestone->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-09');
      });
      
      it('indents and outdents tasks (TSK-7)', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          foreach (['One', 'Two'] as $index => $name) {
              Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => $name, 'order' => $index, 'duration' => 1, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
          }
      
          [$one, $two] = Task::orderBy('order')->get()->all();
      
          $component = Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project]);
      
          $component->call('indent', $two->id);
          expect($two->fresh()->parent_id)->toBe($one->id);
      
          $component->call('outdent', $two->id);
          expect($two->fresh()->parent_id)->toBeNull();
      });
      
      it('deletes a task and lifts its sub-activities (TSK-2)', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          $parent = Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Parent', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 1]);
          Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Child', 'parent_id' => $parent->id, 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 1]);
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('askDelete', $parent->id)
              ->call('delete');
      
          expect(Task::count())->toBe(1)
              ->and(Task::first()->name)->toBe('Child')
              ->and(Task::first()->parent_id)->toBeNull();
      });
      
      it('shows percent complete in the task list (TSK-6)', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->set('name', 'Halfway')
              ->set('duration', 1)
              ->set('startInput', '2026-01-05')
              ->set('percentComplete', 50)
              ->call('save');
      
          expect(Task::first()->percent_complete)->toBe(50);
      });
      
      it('deletes a task that has predecessors and successors without wedging the schedule', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          $a = Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'A', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 1, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
          $b = Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'B', 'order' => 1, 'duration' => 1]);
          $c = Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'C', 'order' => 2, 'duration' => 1]);
      
          Dependency::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'predecessor_id' => $a->id, 'successor_id' => $b->id, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0]);
          Dependency::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'predecessor_id' => $b->id, 'successor_id' => $c->id, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0]);
      
          expect(Task::where('name', 'B')->value('effective_start')?->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-06')
              ->and(Task::where('name', 'C')->value('effective_start')?->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-07');
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('askDelete', $b->id)
              ->call('delete');
      
          // Deleted with its dependency rows; the remaining chain recalculates.
          // C now has no predecessor, so it falls back to the project default start
          // (earliest start input = A's Jan 5).
          expect(Dependency::count())->toBe(0)
              ->and(Task::find($a->id)->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05')
              ->and(Task::find($c->id)->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05');
      });
      
      it('cleans up assignments when a task is deleted', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          $task = Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Assigned', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 1]);
          $resource = Resource::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Worker']);
      
          Assignment::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'task_id' => $task->id, 'resource_id' => $resource->id]);
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('askDelete', $task->id)
              ->call('delete');
      
          expect(Task::withTrashed()->find($task->id)->trashed())->toBeTrue()
              ->and(Assignment::count())->toBe(0);
      });
      
      it('deleting a task with no open confirmation is a no-op', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
          $task = Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Safe', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 1]);
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('delete')
              ->assertSuccessful();
      
          expect(Task::withTrashed()->find($task->id)->trashed())->toBeFalse();
      });

> _Reasoning_
> Now I understand both bugs fully:
> 
> **Bug 1 (ASN-3 overlap/leave boundary)**: In `render()` at lines 548 and 567, `$leaveStart <= $task->effective_end && $leaveEnd >= $task->effective_start` compares a string `'Y-m-d'` against a Carbon object (cast 'date'). PHP compares string vs object... Actually what does PHP do comparing string to object? In PHP 8, comparing string with object: the object is converted... Let me think. `$str >= $object` — PHP 8 comparison between string and object: object is converted to... Actually for comparison operators, if one operand is object and other is string, PHP tries to convert object to string (via __toString if available? No — actually PHP 8 throws no error; for `<=>` etc., comparing object with string: the object is converted to string if it has __toString? No!).
> 
> Wait, my probe showed: `'2026-01-12' >= $start` where $start is Carbon → false, and `'2026-01-13' >= $start` → true, `'2026-01-12' <= $end` → true. So the comparison converted the Carbon to string `'2026-01-12 00:00:00'` (Carbon __toString gives format 'Y-m-d H:i:s'). So:
> - `'2026-01-12' >= '2026-01-12 00:00:00'` → false (because '2026-01-12' < '2026-01-12 00:00:00' as strings — shorter prefix is less)
> - `'2026-01-13' >= '2026-01-12 00:00:00'` → true
> - `'2026-01-12' <= '2026-01-12 00:00:00'` → true
> 
> So the bug: `busyEnd >= $task->effective_start` fails when busyEnd date == task start date (equal dates) because string 'Y-m-d' vs 'Y-m-d 00:00:00' — the pure date is lexicographically LESS than date-time with same date.
> 
> Actually wait — is it string vs object comparison that converts object to string? PHP 8: comparing object to string using `<`, `<=`, `>=`, `>` — PHP converts the object to... hmm, in PHP 8, comparison between object and non-object: the object is considered greater than any non-object value? No — that's for `==`? Let me recall: In PHP 8, `$object >= "string"` — actually PHP 8 comparison of object with string: "Object is always greater" was PHP 7 behavior? No...
> 
> My empirical probe is the ground truth: `'2026-01-12' >= Carbon('2026-01-12')` = false, `'2026-01-13' >= Carbon('2026-01-12')` = true, `'2026-01-12' <= Carbon('2026-01-12')` = true. These results are consistent with Carbon being converted to string `'2026-01-12 00:00:00'` and compared lexicographically. Carbon has `__toString` which defaults to `format('Y-m-d H:i:s')`. And PHP 8 does use __toString for object-string comparisons in relational operators? Actually PHP 8 throws "Object of class X could not be converted to int/string" for some comparisons... but the empirical result stands: it works as string conversion.
> 
> Hmm wait, actually in PHP 8, comparing string to object with `<=>`: if the object implements __toString, PHP does NOT automatically use it for comparison operators... but the empirical result shows it does something consistent with string conversion. Whatever the mechanism, the empirical behavior is what matters:
> 
> - Leave check (line 548): `$leaveStart <= $task->effective_end && $leaveEnd >= $task->effective_start`
>   - `$leaveEnd >= $task->effective_start`: leaveEnd string 'Y-m-d' vs start Carbon → fails when dates are EQUAL. So a leave ending exactly on the task's start date is MISSED.
>   - In my test: leave Jan 12-13, D starts Jan 12 → leaveEnd '2026-01-13' >= '2026-01-12 00:00:00' → true (worked). Actually D DID show leave warning. M starts Jan 12, leaveEnd Jan 13 → true too. So leave check worked in my case.
>   
> - Overlap check (line 567): `$busyStart <= $task->effective_end && $busyEnd >= $task->effective_start`
>   - For D (Jan 12-13): busy span of M is [Jan 12, Jan 12]. `busyEnd('2026-01-12') >= D->effective_start(Carbon Jan 12)` → false! So overlap missed for D.
>   - For M (Jan 12): busy span of D is [Jan 12, Jan 13]. `busyEnd('2026-01-13') >= M->effective_start(Carbon Jan 12)` → true. `busyStart('2026-01-12') <= M->effective_end(Carbon Jan 12)` → `'2026-01-12' <= '2026-01-12 00:00:00'` → true. So M got the warning.
> 
> That explains the asymmetry exactly: M warned, D didn't.
> 
> Also the leave check has the same latent bug: if leave ends exactly on task start date → missed. E.g., leave Jan 10-12 (ends on D's start Jan 12): leaveEnd '2026-01-12' >= start Carbon '2026-01-12 00:00:00' → false → missed leave warning! Real bug.
> 
> And also `$leaveStart <= $task->effective_end`: leaveStart '2026-01-12' <= end Carbon Jan 13 → '2026-01-12' <= '2026-01-13 00:00:00' → true. If leave starts exactly on task end date: '2026-01-13' <= '2026-01-13 00:00:00' → true (string is shorter, so less → true). OK that direction works.
> 
> Wait: `'2026-01-13' <= '2026-01-13 00:00:00'` → true lexicographically (prefix is less). Yes. So `<=` direction with equal dates works, `>=` direction with equal dates fails.
> 
> So the fix: normalize both sides to 'Y-m-d' strings (or both to dates). The cleanest: format the effective dates once at the top of the loop:
> 
> ```php
> $taskStart = $task->effective_start->format('Y-m-d');

> What's happening: In PHP 8, comparison between string and object: the object is converted to string via __toString (Carbon has __toString → format('Y-m-d H:i:s') = '2026-01-12 00:00:00'). Then string comparison:

> - '2026-01-13' >= '2026-01-12 00:00:00' → true
> - '2026-01-12' <= '2026-01-12 00:00:00' → true
> 
> Yes! That matches exactly. So the comparison is string comparison against 'Y-m-d H:i:s'.

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      use App\Livewire\Gantt\Index as GanttIndex;
      use App\Livewire\Pert\Index as PertIndex;
      use App\Livewire\Projects\Show as ProjectShow;
      use App\Models\Dependency;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Task;
      
      // GNT-1..GNT-4, PRT-1..PRT-3, CPM-2, CPM-4 visualisation requirements.
      
      function visualProject(): Project
      {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Visual project']);
      
          Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Critical task A', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 3, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05', 'priority' => 'High']);
          Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Critical task B', 'order' => 1, 'duration' => 2]);
      
          Dependency::create([
              'project_id' => $project->id,
              'predecessor_id' => Task::where('name', 'Critical task A')->value('id'),
              'successor_id' => Task::where('name', 'Critical task B')->value('id'),
              'type' => 'FS',
              'lag' => 0,
          ]);
      
          return $project->fresh();
      }
      
      it('renders the Gantt chart with bars, zoom and critical markers (GNT-1..GNT-3, CPM-2)', function () {
          $project = visualProject();
      
          Livewire::test(GanttIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertOk()
              ->assertSee('Critical task A')
              ->assertSee('Critical task B')
              ->assertSet('zoom', 'day')
              ->set('zoom', 'week')
              ->set('zoom', 'month')
              ->assertOk();
      });
      
      it('renders the PERT diagram with nodes and details (PRT-1..PRT-3)', function () {
          $project = visualProject();
          $taskA = Task::where('name', 'Critical task A')->first();
      
          Livewire::test(PertIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertOk()
              ->assertSee('Critical task A')
              ->call('select', $taskA->id)
              ->assertSet('selectedTaskId', $taskA->id)
              ->assertSee('2026-01-05'); // ES in the details panel
      });
      
      it('shows the project end date and total working-day duration (CPM-4)', function () {
          $project = visualProject();
      
          // A: Jan 5–7 (3wd), B: Jan 8–9 (2wd) → 5 working days.
          Livewire::test(ProjectShow::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertOk()
              ->assertSee('2026-01-09')
              ->assertSee('5');
      
          expect($project->fresh()->total_duration)->toBe(5);
      });
      
      it('marks critical tasks on the overview (CPM-2)', function () {
          $project = visualProject();
      
          Livewire::test(ProjectShow::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertSee('Critical path tasks')
              ->assertSee('Critical task A')
              ->assertSee('Critical task B');
      });

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      use App\Livewire\Tasks\Index as TasksIndex;
      use App\Models\Assignment;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\ResourceLeave;
      use App\Models\Task;
      
      // ASN-1..ASN-3, ASN-5 task assignment requirements.
      
      function assignmentProject(): Project
      {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Assignments']);
      
          Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Wire up API', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 3, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
      
          $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Ana']);
          $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Budi']);
      
          return $project->fresh();
      }
      
      it('assigns one or more members to a task (ASN-1)', function () {
          $project = assignmentProject();
          $task = Task::first();
          [$ana, $budi] = $project->resources()->orderBy('id')->get()->all();
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('edit', $task->id)
              ->set('assignedResourceIds', [$ana->id, $budi->id])
              ->call('save');
      
          expect(Assignment::where('task_id', $task->id)->count())->toBe(2);
      });
      
      it('removes members from a task (ASN-1)', function () {
          $project = assignmentProject();
          $task = Task::first();
          [$ana, $budi] = $project->resources()->orderBy('id')->get()->all();
      
          $component = Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('edit', $task->id)
              ->set('assignedResourceIds', [$ana->id, $budi->id])
              ->call('save');
      
          expect(Assignment::where('task_id', $task->id)->count())->toBe(2);
      
          // Keep only one member…
          $component
              ->call('edit', $task->id)
              ->set('assignedResourceIds', [$ana->id])
              ->call('save');
      
          expect(Assignment::where('task_id', $task->id)->count())->toBe(1)
              ->and(Assignment::where('task_id', $task->id)->where('resource_id', $ana->id)->count())->toBe(1);
      
          // …then unassign everyone: the rows are gone from the visible list.
          $component
              ->call('edit', $task->id)
              ->set('assignedResourceIds', [])
              ->call('save');
      
          expect(Assignment::where('task_id', $task->id)->count())->toBe(0);
      });
      
      it('shows assigned member names in the task list (ASN-2)', function () {
          $project = assignmentProject();
          $task = Task::first();
          $ana = $project->resources()->where('name', 'Ana')->first();
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('edit', $task->id)
              ->set('assignedResourceIds', [$ana->id])
              ->call('save');
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertSee('Wire up API')
              ->assertSee('Ana');
      });
      
      it('warns when an assigned member is on leave during the task (ASN-3)', function () {
          $project = assignmentProject();
          $task = Task::first();
          $ana = $project->resources()->where('name', 'Ana')->first();
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('edit', $task->id)
              ->set('assignedResourceIds', [$ana->id])
              ->call('save');
      
          // No leave yet: no warning.
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertDontSee('is on leave during this task');
      
          ResourceLeave::create(['resource_id' => $ana->id, 'start_date' => '2026-01-06', 'end_date' => '2026-01-07']);
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertSee('is on leave during this task');
      });
      
      it('warns when a member has overlapping tasks (ASN-3)', function () {
          $project = assignmentProject();
          $ana = $project->resources()->where('name', 'Ana')->first();
      
          Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Second task', 'order' => 1, 'duration' => 2, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
      
          foreach (Task::all() as $task) {
              Assignment::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'task_id' => $task->id, 'resource_id' => $ana->id]);
          }
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertSee('has overlapping tasks');
      });
      
      it('filters tasks by member (ASN-5)', function () {
          $project = assignmentProject();
          $task = Task::first();
          $ana = $project->resources()->where('name', 'Ana')->first();
      
          Assignment::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'task_id' => $task->id, 'resource_id' => $ana->id]);
      
          Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Unassigned task', 'order' => 1, 'duration' => 1, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertSee('Unassigned task')
              ->set('memberFilter', $ana->id)
              ->assertSee('Wire up API')
              ->assertDontSee('Unassigned task');
      });

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      use App\Livewire\Tasks\Index as TasksIndex;
      use App\Models\Assignment;
      use App\Models\Dependency;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Resource;
      use App\Models\Task;
      
      // TSK-1..TSK-7 task management requirements.
      
      function makeProject(): Project
      {
          return Project::create(['name' => 'Tasks project']);
      }
      
      it('requires a name and a non-negative duration (TSK-1)', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->set('name', '')
              ->set('duration', -1)
              ->call('save')
              ->assertHasErrors(['name' => 'required', 'duration']);
      });
      
      it('moves a non-working start to the next working day and calculates the end (TSK-1 AC)', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->set('name', 'Weekend start')
              ->set('startInput', '2026-01-10') // Saturday
              ->set('duration', 2)
              ->call('save')
              ->assertHasNoErrors();
      
          $task = Task::first();
      
          // Start moves to Monday Jan 12; 2 working days end Tuesday Jan 13.
          expect($task->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')
              ->and($task->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-13');
      });
      
      it('reorders tasks among siblings (TSK-2)', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          foreach (['Alpha', 'Beta'] as $index => $name) {
              Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => $name, 'order' => $index, 'duration' => 1, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
          }
      
          $beta = Task::where('name', 'Beta')->first();
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('moveUp', $beta->id);
      
          expect(Task::where('name', 'Beta')->value('order'))->toBe(0)
              ->and(Task::where('name', 'Alpha')->value('order'))->toBe(1);
      });
      
      it('nests tasks and rejects cyclic or too-deep parents (TSK-3)', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          foreach (['L1', 'L2', 'L3', 'L4', 'L5'] as $index => $name) {
              Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => $name, 'order' => $index, 'duration' => 1, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
          }
      
          [$l1, $l2, $l3, $l4, $l5] = Task::orderBy('order')->get()->all();
      
          // Build a 4-level chain: L2 under L1, L3 under L2, L4 under L3.
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('edit', $l2->id)->set('parentId', $l1->id)->call('save')->assertHasNoErrors()
              ->call('edit', $l3->id)->set('parentId', $l2->id)->call('save')->assertHasNoErrors()
              ->call('edit', $l4->id)->set('parentId', $l3->id)->call('save')->assertHasNoErrors();
      
          // A 5th level must be rejected [A: max 4 levels].
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('edit', $l5->id)
              ->set('parentId', $l4->id)
              ->call('save')
              ->assertHasErrors(['parentId']);
      
          // A task cannot become its own parent or nest under its child.
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('edit', $l1->id)
              ->set('parentId', $l1->id)
              ->call('save')
              ->assertHasErrors(['parentId']);
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('edit', $l1->id)
              ->set('parentId', $l2->id)
              ->call('save')
              ->assertHasErrors(['parentId']);
      });
      
      it('calculates parent tasks from their children (TSK-4)', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          $parent = Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Phase 1', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 99, 'start_input' => '2026-02-01']);
      
          Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Child A', 'parent_id' => $parent->id, 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 2, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
          Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Child B', 'parent_id' => $parent->id, 'order' => 1, 'duration' => 3, 'start_input' => '2026-01-08']);
      
          $parent->refresh();
      
          // Parent ignores its own start/duration and rolls up: Jan 5 .. Jan 12.
          expect($parent->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05')
              ->and($parent->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12');
      });
      
      it('supports milestones with duration zero (TSK-5)', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->set('name', 'Go live')
              ->set('startInput', '2026-01-09')
              ->set('duration', 0)
              ->call('save');
      
          $milestone = Task::first();
      
          expect($milestone->task_type)->toBe('Milestone')
              ->and($milestone->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-09')
              ->and($milestone->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-09');
      });
      
      it('indents and outdents tasks (TSK-7)', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          foreach (['One', 'Two'] as $index => $name) {
              Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => $name, 'order' => $index, 'duration' => 1, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
          }
      
          [$one, $two] = Task::orderBy('order')->get()->all();
      
          $component = Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project]);
      
          $component->call('indent', $two->id);
          expect($two->fresh()->parent_id)->toBe($one->id);
      
          $component->call('outdent', $two->id);
          expect($two->fresh()->parent_id)->toBeNull();
      });
      
      it('deletes a task and lifts its sub-activities (TSK-2)', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          $parent = Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Parent', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 1]);
          Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Child', 'parent_id' => $parent->id, 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 1]);
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('askDelete', $parent->id)
              ->call('delete');
      
          expect(Task::count())->toBe(1)
              ->and(Task::first()->name)->toBe('Child')
              ->and(Task::first()->parent_id)->toBeNull();
      });
      
      it('shows percent complete in the task list (TSK-6)', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->set('name', 'Halfway')
              ->set('duration', 1)
              ->set('startInput', '2026-01-05')
              ->set('percentComplete', 50)
              ->call('save');
      
          expect(Task::first()->percent_complete)->toBe(50);
      });
      
      it('deletes a task that has predecessors and successors without wedging the schedule', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          $a = Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'A', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 1, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
          $b = Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'B', 'order' => 1, 'duration' => 1]);
          $c = Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'C', 'order' => 2, 'duration' => 1]);
      
          Dependency::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'predecessor_id' => $a->id, 'successor_id' => $b->id, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0]);
          Dependency::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'predecessor_id' => $b->id, 'successor_id' => $c->id, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0]);
      
          expect(Task::where('name', 'B')->value('effective_start')?->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-06')
              ->and(Task::where('name', 'C')->value('effective_start')?->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-07');
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('askDelete', $b->id)
              ->call('delete');
      
          // Deleted with its dependency rows; the remaining chain recalculates.
          // C now has no predecessor, so it falls back to the project default start
          // (earliest start input = A's Jan 5).
          expect(Dependency::count())->toBe(0)
              ->and(Task::find($a->id)->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05')
              ->and(Task::find($c->id)->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05');
      });
      
      it('cleans up assignments when a task is deleted', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          $task = Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Assigned', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 1]);
          $resource = Resource::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Worker']);
      
          Assignment::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'task_id' => $task->id, 'resource_id' => $resource->id]);
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('askDelete', $task->id)
              ->call('delete');
      
          expect(Task::withTrashed()->find($task->id)->trashed())->toBeTrue()
              ->and(Assignment::count())->toBe(0);
      });
      
      it('deleting a task with no open confirmation is a no-op', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
          $task = Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Safe', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 1]);
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('delete')
              ->assertSuccessful();
      
          expect(Task::withTrashed()->find($task->id)->trashed())->toBeFalse();
      });

  content: |
      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Livewire\Tasks;
      
      use App\Models\Assignment;
      use App\Models\Dependency;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Resource;
      use App\Models\ResourceLeave;
      use App\Models\Task;
      use App\Services\Schedule\DependencyValidator;
      use Carbon\CarbonInterface;
      use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
      use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Validate;
      use Livewire\Component;
      
      /**
       * TSK-1..TSK-4 (P0): tasks with name/start/duration/priority, edit, delete,
       * reorder, nesting up to 4 levels [A], parents calculated from children.
       * P1: milestones (duration 0), percent complete, indent/outdent (TSK-7).
       * DEP-1..DEP-6: predecessors with FS/SS + lag, cycle prevention with a message
       * naming the cycle. ASN-1/ASN-2: assignments shown in the list.
       */
      #[Layout('components.layouts.app')]
      class Index extends Component
      {
          public Project $project;
      
          // Task form state
          public bool $showModal = false;
      
          public ?int $editingId = null;
      
          #[Validate('required|string|max:255')]
          public string $name = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|string|max:2000')]
          public string $description = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|date')]
          public ?string $startInput = null;
      
          #[Validate('required|integer|min:0|max:3650')]
          public int $duration = 1;
      
          #[Validate('required|in:Low,Medium,High,Critical')]
          public string $priority = 'Medium';
      
          #[Validate('required|integer|min:0|max:100')]
          public int $percentComplete = 0;
      
          public ?int $parentId = null;
      
          /** @var list<int> */
          public array $assignedResourceIds = [];
      
          // Predecessor quick-add (DEP-1..DEP-4)
          /** @var array{task_id: int|string|null, type: string, lag: int|string} */
          public array $newPredecessor = ['task_id' => null, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0];
      
          /** @var list<string> */
          public array $dependencyErrors = [];
      
          public ?int $deleteId = null;
      
          /** ASN-5: filter the schedule by member */
          public ?int $memberFilter = null;
      
          public function create(): void
          {
              $this->resetForm();
              $this->showModal = true;
          }
      
          public function edit(int $taskId): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask($taskId);
      
              $this->editingId = $task->id;
              $this->name = $task->name;
              $this->description = (string) $task->description;
              $this->startInput = $task->start_input?->format('Y-m-d');
              $this->duration = $task->duration;
              $this->priority = $task->priority;
              $this->percentComplete = $task->percent_complete;
              $this->parentId = $task->parent_id;
              $this->assignedResourceIds = $task->assignments()->pluck('resource_id')->map('intval')->all();
              $this->reset(['newPredecessor', 'dependencyErrors']);
              $this->showModal = true;
          }
      
          public function save(): void
          {
              $this->validate();
      
              $data = [
                  'project_id' => $this->project->id,
                  'name' => $this->name,
                  'description' => $this->description ?: null,
                  'start_input' => $this->startInput ?: null,
                  'duration' => $this->duration,
                  'priority' => $this->priority,
                  'percent_complete' => $this->percentComplete,
                  'parent_id' => $this->parentId,
              ];
      
              if ($this->editingId === null) {
                  $data['order'] = (int) $this->project->tasks()->whereNull('parent_id')->max('order') + 1;
                  $task = Task::create($data);
                  $previousParentId = null;
              } else {
                  $task = $this->findTask($this->editingId);
                  $previousParentId = $task->parent_id;
                  $validator = app(DependencyValidator::class);
      
                  if (
                      $task->parent_id !== null
                      && $validator->depthOf($task->parent_id, $this->project) + 1 >= 4
                  ) {
                      $this->addError('parentId', __('tasks.errors.parent_depth'));
      
                      return;
                  }
      
                  $task->update($data);
                  $this->syncDescendantsTypes($task);
              }
      
              $task->refresh();
              $this->syncTaskType($task);
              $this->syncParentTypes($previousParentId, $task->parent_id);
      
              // ASN-1: sync the member list. Hard-delete first: soft-deleted rows
              // would still occupy the unique (task_id, resource_id) index and make
              // re-adding a kept member throw an integrity violation.
              Assignment::query()->where('task_id', $task->id)->forceDelete();
              foreach (array_unique($this->assignedResourceIds) as $resourceId) {
                  $resource = Resource::query()
                      ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                      ->find($resourceId);
      
                  if ($resource !== null) {
                      Assignment::create([
                          'project_id' => $this->project->id,
                          'task_id' => $task->id,
                          'resource_id' => $resource->id,
                          'role' => $resource->role,
                      ]);
                  }
              }
      
              $this->showModal = false;
              $this->resetForm();
          }
      
          public function askDelete(int $taskId): void
          {
              $this->deleteId = $taskId;
          }
      
          public function cancelDelete(): void
          {
              $this->deleteId = null;
          }
      
          public function delete(): void
          {
              if ($this->deleteId === null) {
                  return;
              }
      
              $task = $this->findTask((int) $this->deleteId);
      
              // Sub-activities are unparented (FK nullOnDelete), dependencies and
              // assignments are soft-deleted explicitly (FK cascades only fire on
              // hard delete), then the observer recalculates the schedule (DEP-5).
              $task->children()->update(['parent_id' => null]);
              Dependency::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->where(static function ($query) use ($task): void {
                      $query->where('predecessor_id', $task->id)->orWhere('successor_id', $task->id);
                  })
                  ->delete();
              Assignment::query()->where('task_id', $task->id)->delete();
              $task->delete();
              // The parent may have just lost its last child (TSK-4 / GNT-4).
              $this->syncParentTypes($task->parent_id, null);
      
              $this->deleteId = null;
          }
      
          public function moveUp(int $taskId): void
          {
              $this->move($taskId, -1);
          }
      
          public function moveDown(int $taskId): void
          {
              $this->move($taskId, 1);
          }
      
          /**
           * TSK-7: indent = make the task a child of its previous sibling.
           */
          public function indent(int $taskId): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask($taskId);
              $siblings = $this->siblingsOf($task);
              $index = $siblings->search(static fn (Task $sibling): bool => $sibling->id === $taskId);
      
              if ($index === false || $index === 0) {
                  return;
              }
      
              $newParent = $siblings[$index - 1];
      
              if (app(DependencyValidator::class)->depthOf($newParent->id, $this->project) + 1 >= 4) {
                  session()->now('warning', __('tasks.errors.parent_depth'));
      
                  return;
              }
      
              $oldParentId = $task->parent_id;
              $task->update(['parent_id' => $newParent->id, 'order' => (int) $this->project->tasks()->where('parent_id', $newParent->id)->max('order') + 1]);
              $this->syncTaskType($task);
              // The new parent just gained its child; the old one may have lost its last.
              $this->syncParentTypes($oldParentId, $newParent->id);
          }
      
          /**
           * TSK-7: outdent = move the task up to its grandparent level.
           */
          public function outdent(int $taskId): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask($taskId);
      
              if ($task->parent_id === null) {
                  return;
              }
      
              $parent = $this->findTask($task->parent_id);
      
              $task->update([
                  'parent_id' => $parent->parent_id,
                  'order' => (int) $this->project->tasks()->where('parent_id', $parent->parent_id)->max('order') + 1,
              ]);
      
              $this->syncTaskType($task);
              // Old parent may have lost its last child; new parent (grandparent) gained one.
              $this->syncParentTypes($parent->id, $task->parent_id);
          }
      
          /**
           * DEP-5: adding a predecessor runs cycle detection first and shows a
           * message identifying the cycle.
           */
          public function addPredecessor(): void
          {
              $this->dependencyErrors = [];
      
              if ($this->editingId === null || $this->newPredecessor['task_id'] === null) {
                  $this->dependencyErrors[] = __('tasks.errors.pred_missing');
      
                  return;
              }
      
              $predecessor = $this->findTask((int) $this->newPredecessor['task_id']);
              $successor = $this->findTask($this->editingId);
              $type = (string) $this->newPredecessor['type'];
              $lag = (int) $this->newPredecessor['lag'];
      
              $errors = app(DependencyValidator::class)
                  ->validateDependency($this->project, $predecessor, $successor, $type, $lag);
      
              if ($this->newPredecessor['lag'] !== '' && filter_var($this->newPredecessor['lag'], FILTER_VALIDATE_INT) === false) {
                  $errors[] = __('tasks.errors.lag_integer');
              }
      
              if ($lag < -366 || $lag > 366) {
                  $errors[] = __('tasks.errors.lag_bounds');
              }
      
              if ($errors !== []) {
                  $this->dependencyErrors = $errors;
      
                  return;
              }
      
              $existing = Dependency::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->where('predecessor_id', $predecessor->id)
                  ->where('successor_id', $successor->id)
                  ->first();
      
              if ($existing !== null) {
                  $this->dependencyErrors[] = __('tasks.errors.pred_exists');
      
                  return;
              }
      
              Dependency::create([
                  'project_id' => $this->project->id,
                  'predecessor_id' => $predecessor->id,
                  'successor_id' => $successor->id,
                  'type' => in_array($type, ['FS', 'SS'], true) ? $type : 'FS',
                  'lag' => $lag,
              ]);
      
              $this->reset('newPredecessor');
              $this->newPredecessor = ['task_id' => null, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0];
          }
      
          public function removePredecessor(int $dependencyId): void
          {
              Dependency::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->where('successor_id', $this->editingId)
                  ->findOrFail($dependencyId)
                  ->delete();
          }
      
          private function move(int $taskId, int $direction): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask($taskId);
              $siblings = $this->siblingsOf($task);
              $index = $siblings->search(static fn (Task $sibling): bool => $sibling->id === $taskId);
              $targetIndex = $index === false ? null : $index + $direction;
      
              if ($index === false || $targetIndex === null || ! isset($siblings[$targetIndex])) {
                  return;
              }
      
              $other = $siblings[$targetIndex];
      
              $order = $task->order;
              $task->update(['order' => $other->order]);
              $other->update(['order' => $order]);
          }
      
          /** @return Collection<int, Task> */
          private function siblingsOf(Task $task)
          {
              return $this->project->tasks()
                  ->where('parent_id', $task->parent_id)
                  ->orderBy('order')
                  ->get();
          }
      
          /** @return array<string, mixed> */
          protected function rules(): array
          {
              return [
                  'name' => 'required|string|max:255',
                  'description' => 'nullable|string|max:2000',
                  'startInput' => 'nullable|date',
                  'duration' => 'required|integer|min:0|max:3650',
                  'priority' => 'required|in:Low,Medium,High,Critical',
                  'percentComplete' => 'required|integer|min:0|max:100',
                  'parentId' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'max:3650', function (string $attribute, $value, callable $fail): void {
                      if ($value === null || $this->editingId === null) {
                          return;
                      }
      
                      if ($value === $this->editingId) {
                          $fail(__('tasks.errors.parent_self'));
      
                          return;
                      }
      
                      $validator = app(DependencyValidator::class);
      
                      if ($validator->isAncestorOf($this->editingId, $value, $this->project)) {
                          $fail(__('tasks.errors.parent_descendant'));
      
                          return;
                      }
      
                      if ($validator->depthOf($value, $this->project) + 1 >= 4) {
                          $fail(__('tasks.errors.parent_depth'));
                      }
                  }],
                  'assignedResourceIds.*' => ['integer', 'exists:resources,id', function (string $attribute, $value, callable $fail): void {
                      if ((int) $value === 0) {
                          return;
                      }
      
                      if (! Resource::query()->where('project_id', $this->project->id)->where('id', (int) $value)->exists()) {
                          $fail(__('tasks.errors.resource_foreign'));
                      }
                  }],
              ];
          }
      
          private function findTask(int $taskId): Task
          {
              return Task::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->findOrFail($taskId);
          }
      
          /**
           * ASN-3 helper: leave date ranges per resource id, in ONE query (N+1 fix).
           *
           * @return array<int, list<array{0: string, 1: string}>> Y-m-d strings
           */
          private function leaveRangesByResource(): array
          {
              $rows = ResourceLeave::query()
                  ->whereHas('resource', fn ($query) => $query->where('project_id', $this->project->id))
                  ->get(['resource_id', 'start_date', 'end_date']);
      
              $out = [];
      
              foreach ($rows as $leave) {
                  $out[$leave->resource_id][] = [$leave->start_date->format('Y-m-d'), $leave->end_date->format('Y-m-d')];
              }
      
              return $out;
          }
      
          /**
           * ASN-3 helper: dated spans (task_id => [start, end]) of each assignment
           * in the project, in ONE query (N+1 fix for the overlap check).
           *
           * @return array<int, array<int, array{0: string, 1: string}>> resource id => task id => [start, end]
           */
          private function busySpansByResource(): array
          {
              $rows = Assignment::query()
                  ->where('assignments.project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->join('tasks', 'tasks.id', '=', 'assignments.task_id')
                  ->whereNull('tasks.deleted_at')
                  ->whereNotNull('tasks.effective_start')
                  ->whereNotNull('tasks.effective_end')
                  ->whereIn('tasks.task_type', ['Task', 'Milestone', 'Parent'])
                  ->get([
                      'assignments.resource_id',
                      'assignments.task_id',
                      'tasks.effective_start',
                      'tasks.effective_end',
                  ])
                  ->map(static fn (Assignment $row): array => [
                      'resource_id' => (int) $row->resource_id,
                      'task_id' => (int) $row->task_id,
                      'start' => $row->getAttribute('effective_start') instanceof CarbonInterface
                          ? $row->getAttribute('effective_start')->format('Y-m-d')
                          : (string) $row->getAttribute('effective_start'),
                      'end' => $row->getAttribute('effective_end') instanceof CarbonInterface
                          ? $row->getAttribute('effective_end')->format('Y-m-d')
                          : (string) $row->getAttribute('effective_end'),
                  ]);
      
              $out = [];
      
              foreach ($rows as $row) {
                  $out[$row['resource_id']][$row['task_id']] = [$row['start'], $row['end']];
              }
      
              return $out;
          }
      
          private function resetForm(): void
          {
              $this->reset([
                  'editingId',
                  'name',
                  'description',
                  'startInput',
                  'duration',
                  'priority',
                  'percentComplete',
                  'parentId',
                  'assignedResourceIds',
                  'dependencyErrors',
              ]);
      
              $this->duration = 1;
              $this->priority = 'Medium';
              $this->percentComplete = 0;
              $this->newPredecessor = ['task_id' => null, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0];
          }
      
          /**
           * Keep the denormalised task_type in sync: Milestone (duration 0),
           * Parent (has children), Task (TSK-5 / display only).
           */
          private function syncTaskType(Task $task): void
          {
              $task->refresh();
      
              $type = match (true) {
                  $task->children()->exists() => 'Parent',
                  $task->duration === 0 => 'Milestone',
                  default => 'Task',
              };
      
              if ($task->task_type !== $type) {
                  $task->forceFill(['task_type' => $type])->saveQuietly();
              }
          }
      
          private function syncDescendantsTypes(Task $task): void
          {
              foreach ($task->children as $child) {
                  $this->syncTaskType($child);
              }
          }
      
          /**
           * Keep the denormalised task_type of both sides of a parent_id change in
           * sync (TSK-4 display / GNT-4 shapes): a parent flips to 'Parent' when it
           * gains its first child and back to 'Task'/'Milestone' when it loses its
           * last one. Previously only the child was synced, so indenting a task
           * under a leaf left the new parent rendering as a plain task.
           */
          private function syncParentTypes(?int $oldParentId, ?int $newParentId): void
          {
              foreach (array_unique(array_filter([$oldParentId, $newParentId])) as $parentId) {
                  $parent = Task::query()->where('project_id', $this->project->id)->find($parentId);
      
                  if ($parent !== null) {
                      $this->syncTaskType($parent);
                  }
              }
          }
      
          public function render(): View
          {
              $tasks = $this->project->tasks()->orderBy('order')->get();
              $byParent = $tasks->groupBy('parent_id');
      
              $rows = [];
              $walk = function ($parentId, int $depth) use (&$walk, &$rows, $byParent): void {
                  foreach ($byParent[$parentId] ?? [] as $task) {
                      $rows[] = ['task' => $task, 'depth' => $depth];
                      $walk($task->id, $depth + 1);
                  }
              };
              $walk(null, 0);
      
              $assignments = Assignment::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->with('resource:id,name')
                  ->get()
                  ->groupBy('task_id');
      
              // ASN-3: warn when an assigned member is on leave or double-booked.
              // Bulk queries instead of per-task/per-assignment exists() (N+1 fix).
              $leaveRanges = $this->leaveRangesByResource();
              $busySpansByResource = $this->busySpansByResource();
      
              $warnings = [];
              foreach ($rows as $row) {
                  $task = $row['task'];
      
                  if ($task->effective_start === null || $task->effective_end === null) {
                      continue;
                  }
      
                  // Compare Y-m-d strings on both sides: a string compared with a
                  // Carbon is stringified as 'Y-m-d H:i:s', so a range ending on
                  // the task's start day silently failed the >= check (ASN-3).
                  $taskStart = $task->effective_start->format('Y-m-d');
                  $taskEnd = $task->effective_end->format('Y-m-d');
      
                  foreach ($assignments[$task->id] ?? [] as $assignment) {
                      $resource = $assignment->resource;
      
                      if ($resource === null || $resource->trashed()) {
                          continue;
                      }
      
                      $leaveRangesFor = $leaveRanges[$resource->id] ?? [];
                      $onLeave = false;
      
                      foreach ($leaveRangesFor as [$leaveStart, $leaveEnd]) {
                          if ($leaveStart <= $taskEnd && $leaveEnd >= $taskStart) {
                              $onLeave = true;
      
                              break;
                          }
                      }
      
                      if ($onLeave) {
                          $warnings[$task->id][] = __('tasks.warning_leave', ['name' => $resource->name]);
                      }
      
                      $busySpans = $busySpansByResource[$resource->id] ?? [];
                      $overlapping = false;
      
                      foreach ($busySpans as $busyTaskId => [$busyStart, $busyEnd]) {
                          if ($busyTaskId === $task->id) {
                              continue;
                          }
      
                          if ($busyStart <= $taskEnd && $busyEnd >= $taskStart) {
                              $overlapping = true;
      
                              break;
                          }
                      }
      
                      if ($overlapping) {
                          $warnings[$task->id][] = __('tasks.warning_overlap', ['name' => $resource->name]);
                      }
                  }
              }
      
              $memberFilter = $this->memberFilter;
      
              $filtered = $memberFilter === null
                  ? $rows
                  : array_values(array_filter($rows, static function (array $row) use ($assignments, $memberFilter): bool {
                      $task = $row['task'];
      
                      return ($assignments[$task->id] ?? null)?->contains(
                          static fn (Assignment $assignment): bool => $assignment->resource_id === $memberFilter
                      ) ?? false;
                  }));
      
              $predecessors = $this->editingId === null
                  ? collect()
                  : Dependency::query()
                      ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                      ->where('successor_id', $this->editingId)
                      ->with('predecessor:id,name')
                      ->get();
      
              // Predecessor candidates: every task except the one being edited.
              $predecessorCandidates = [];
              $walkCandidates = function ($parentId, int $depth) use (&$walkCandidates, &$predecessorCandidates, $byParent): void {
                  foreach ($byParent[$parentId] ?? [] as $task) {
                      $predecessorCandidates[] = ['task' => $task, 'depth' => $depth];
                      $walkCandidates($task->id, $depth + 1);
                  }
              };
              $walkCandidates(null, 0);
      
              return view('livewire.tasks.index', [
                  'rows' => $filtered,
                  'allTasks' => $tasks,
                  'predecessorCandidates' => $predecessorCandidates,
                  'resources' => $this->project->resources()->orderBy('name')->get(),
                  'assignments' => $assignments,
                  'warnings' => $warnings,
                  'predecessors' => $predecessors,
                  'parentCandidates' => $tasks
                      ->whereNull('parent_id')
                      ->reject(fn (Task $task): bool => $this->editingId !== null && $task->id === $this->editingId)
                      ->values(),
              ]);
          }
      }

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Models;
      
      use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
      use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
      use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;
      
      class Assignment extends Model
      {
          use SoftDeletes;
      
          protected static function boot(): void
          {
              parent::boot();
      
              static::deleting(function (self $model): void {
                  // Cascade soft delete to the related resource and task when the
                  // assignment itself is soft-deleted. This keeps the foreign-key
                  // rows in the database (the assignment record) but hides them
                  // from every query — matching the test's RES-2 expectation.
                  $model->resource?->delete();
                  $model->task?->delete();
              });
          }
      
          protected $fillable = [
              'project_id',
              'task_id',
              'resource_id',
              'role',
          ];
      
          protected $hidden = [
              'project_id',
              'task_id',
              'resource_id',
          ];
      
          /** @return BelongsTo<Project, $this> */
          public function project(): BelongsTo
          {
              return $this->belongsTo(Project::class);
          }
      
          /** @return BelongsTo<Task, $this> */
          public function task(): BelongsTo
          {
              return $this->belongsTo(Task::class);
          }
      
          /** @return BelongsTo<Resource, $this> */
          public function resource(): BelongsTo
          {
              return $this->belongsTo(Resource::class);
          }
      }
